# CLI commands

The [CLI guide](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/guide/cli) shows the common workflows. This page lists everything, and is generated from the same table that drives `--help`.

## Common flags

::field-group
  :::field{name="--cwd" type="string"}
  Project directory

  **Default** current directory
  :::

  :::field{name="--logLevel" type="string"}
  Output level: `silent`, `info`

  **Default** `info`
  :::

  :::field{name="--debug" type="boolean"}
  Print a stack trace when a command fails

  **Default** `false`
  :::
::

## Inspect

### `info`

Print the resolved i18n configuration of the project

::field-group
  :::field{name="--json" type="boolean"}
  Print JSON instead of text

  **Default** `false`
  :::
::

### `check`

The CI gate: fail on missing, empty, extra, undefined or unused keys and broken placeholders

::field-group
  :::field{name="--translationDir" type="string"}
  Translation directory, relative to the project

  **Default** `i18n.translationDir` of nuxt.config
  :::

  :::field{name="--only" type="string"}
  Comma-separated checks to run: missing, empty, extra, placeholders, undefined, unused, duplicates. `unused` named here fails when it cannot run

  **Default** all but duplicates
  :::

  :::field{name="--duplicates" type="boolean"}
  Also report the same text under different keys

  **Default** `false`
  :::

  :::field{name="--ignore" type="string"}
  Comma-separated globs of source files to skip, relative to the project
  :::

  :::field{name="--json" type="boolean"}
  Print JSON instead of text

  **Default** `false`
  :::
::

```bash
i18n-micro check
i18n-micro check --only missing,placeholders --json
```

### `stats`

Show translation completion per locale

::field-group
  :::field{name="--translationDir" type="string"}
  Translation directory, relative to the project

  **Default** `i18n.translationDir` of nuxt.config
  :::

  :::field{name="--html" type="string"}
  Also write an HTML report to this file
  :::

  :::field{name="--json" type="boolean"}
  Print JSON instead of text

  **Default** `false`
  :::

  :::field{name="--baseRef" type="string"}
  Git ref to compare completion with, e.g. HEAD\~1 or main
  :::
::

```bash
i18n-micro stats --baseRef main
i18n-micro stats --html reports/i18n.html
```

### `lint`

Check the text of translations; fails when issues remain

::field-group
  :::field{name="--translationDir" type="string"}
  Translation directory, relative to the project

  **Default** `i18n.translationDir` of nuxt.config
  :::

  :::field{name="--rules" type="string"}
  Comma-separated rules to run: no-trailing-spaces, no-multiple-spaces, no-empty-translation, or a custom one

  **Default** all, or `enabledRules` of .i18n-lintrc.json
  :::

  :::field{name="--fix" type="boolean"}
  Fix what can be fixed: spaces, and custom rules with a replacement

  **Default** `false`
  :::

  :::field{name="--json" type="boolean"}
  Print JSON instead of text

  **Default** `false`
  :::
::

```bash
i18n-micro lint --rules no-trailing-spaces --fix
```

### `search`

Search keys and values, and show where each key is used

::field-group
  :::field{name="--translationDir" type="string"}
  Translation directory, relative to the project

  **Default** `i18n.translationDir` of nuxt.config
  :::

  :::field{name="<query>" type="string"}
  Text or key to search for
  :::

  :::field{name="--caseSensitive" type="boolean"}
  Match case

  **Default** `false`
  :::

  :::field{name="--onlyUnused" type="boolean"}
  Only keys `clean` would remove; the query becomes optional

  **Default** `false`
  :::

  :::field{name="--scope" type="string"}
  Where to search: `global`, `pages`, `all`

  **Default** `all`
  :::

  :::field{name="--limit" type="string"}
  Return at most this many keys
  :::

  :::field{name="--ignore" type="string"}
  Comma-separated globs of source files to skip, relative to the project
  :::

  :::field{name="--json" type="boolean"}
  Print JSON instead of text

  **Default** `false`
  :::
::

```bash
i18n-micro search "Welcome"
i18n-micro search --onlyUnused
```

## Translation workflow

### `extract`

List the keys source files use that have no text yet, and add those with a default text to the default locale

::field-group
  :::field{name="--translationDir" type="string"}
  Translation directory, relative to the project

  **Default** `i18n.translationDir` of nuxt.config
  :::

  :::field{name="--ignore" type="string"}
  Comma-separated globs of source files to skip, relative to the project
  :::
::

```bash
i18n-micro extract
```

### `translate`

Fill missing translations from the default locale through a translation service

::field-group
  :::field{name="--translationDir" type="string"}
  Translation directory, relative to the project

  **Default** `i18n.translationDir` of nuxt.config
  :::

  :::field{name="--service" type="string"}
  Translation service: ai, azure, deepl, google, libretranslate, yandexcloud
  :::

  :::field{name="--token" type="string"}
  API key. Prefer the I18N_TRANSLATE_TOKEN environment variable: flags end up in shell history
  :::

  :::field{name="--options" type="string"}
  Service options as key\:value pairs, separated by commas
  :::

  :::field{name="--locale" type="string"}
  Comma-separated locales to fill

  **Default** every locale but the default one
  :::

  :::field{name="--replace" type="boolean"}
  Translate every key again, replacing existing values

  **Default** `false`
  :::

  :::field{name="--dryRun" type="boolean"}
  Count keys and characters per locale; send nothing

  **Default** `false`
  :::

  :::field{name="--chunkSize" type="string"}
  Strings per request; capped at what the service accepts
  :::

  :::field{name="--pluralSeparator" type="string"}
  Separator of plural forms in messages

  **Default** `|`
  :::

  :::field{name="--glossaryFile" type="string"}
  Glossary file, used by the `ai` service

  **Default** `.i18n-glossary.json` when it exists
  :::
::

```bash
i18n-micro translate --dryRun
I18N_TRANSLATE_TOKEN=... i18n-micro translate --service deepl --locale de,fr
i18n-micro translate --service ai --options provider:openai,model:gpt-4o-mini
i18n-micro translate --service libretranslate --options baseUrl:https://translate.example.com
```

### `sync`

Remove keys the default locale does not have; stops when that cannot be proven safe. Missing keys stay missing

::field-group
  :::field{name="--translationDir" type="string"}
  Translation directory, relative to the project

  **Default** `i18n.translationDir` of nuxt.config
  :::

  :::field{name="--ignore" type="string"}
  Comma-separated globs of source files to skip, relative to the project
  :::

  :::field{name="--dryRun" type="boolean"}
  List what would be removed; write nothing

  **Default** `false`
  :::

  :::field{name="--force" type="boolean"}
  Remove keys even though it cannot be proven safe

  **Default** `false`
  :::
::

```bash
i18n-micro sync --dryRun
```

### `clean`

Remove keys nothing in the project uses; stops when that cannot be proven

::field-group
  :::field{name="--translationDir" type="string"}
  Translation directory, relative to the project

  **Default** `i18n.translationDir` of nuxt.config
  :::

  :::field{name="--include" type="string"}
  Regular expression: consider only matching keys for removal
  :::

  :::field{name="--exclude" type="string"}
  Regular expression: never remove matching keys
  :::

  :::field{name="--ignore" type="string"}
  Comma-separated globs of source files to skip, relative to the project
  :::

  :::field{name="--dryRun" type="boolean"}
  List what would be removed; write nothing

  **Default** `false`
  :::

  :::field{name="--force" type="boolean"}
  Remove keys even though usage cannot be proven for all of them

  **Default** `false`
  :::
::

```bash
i18n-micro clean --dryRun
i18n-micro clean --exclude '^errors\.'
```

## Refactoring

### `text-to-i18n`

Replace hardcoded text in Vue templates with translation calls, and report hardcoded text in code

::field-group
  :::field{name="--translationFile" type="string"}
  File the new keys go to

  **Default** `<translationDir>/<defaultLocale>.json`
  :::

  :::field{name="--path" type="string"}
  File or directory to process

  **Default** the whole project
  :::

  :::field{name="--context" type="string"}
  Prefix for generated keys
  :::

  :::field{name="--ignore" type="string"}
  Comma-separated globs of source files to skip, relative to the project
  :::

  :::field{name="--dryRun" type="boolean"}
  Show what would change; write nothing

  **Default** `false`
  :::

  :::field{name="--interactive" type="boolean"}
  Confirm or edit every generated key

  **Default** `false`
  :::
::

```bash
i18n-micro text-to-i18n --dryRun
i18n-micro text-to-i18n --path components --context ui
```

### `rename`

Rename a key or a namespace in every locale and in source files

::field-group
  :::field{name="--translationDir" type="string"}
  Translation directory, relative to the project

  **Default** `i18n.translationDir` of nuxt.config
  :::

  :::field{required name="--from" type="string"}
  Current key or namespace
  :::

  :::field{required name="--to" type="string"}
  New key or namespace
  :::

  :::field{name="--ignore" type="string"}
  Comma-separated globs of source files to skip, relative to the project
  :::

  :::field{name="--dryRun" type="boolean"}
  Report the changes; write nothing

  **Default** `false`
  :::
::

```bash
i18n-micro rename --from common.save --to actions.save
```

### `pseudo`

Fill a locale with pseudo-translations to find layout and hardcoded-text issues

::field-group
  :::field{name="--translationDir" type="string"}
  Translation directory, relative to the project

  **Default** `i18n.translationDir` of nuxt.config
  :::

  :::field{name="--sourceLocale" type="string"}
  Locale to read

  **Default** the default locale
  :::

  :::field{required name="--targetLocale" type="string"}
  Locale to fill
  :::

  :::field{name="--replace" type="boolean"}
  Overwrite existing values

  **Default** `false`
  :::
::

### `format`

Rewrite locale files with sorted keys and uniform indentation

::field-group
  :::field{name="--translationDir" type="string"}
  Translation directory, relative to the project

  **Default** `i18n.translationDir` of nuxt.config
  :::

  :::field{name="--indent" type="string"}
  Spaces of indentation

  **Default** `2`
  :::

  :::field{name="--sortKeys" type="boolean"}
  Sort keys; use --no-sortKeys to keep their order

  **Default** `true`
  :::

  :::field{name="--check" type="boolean"}
  Fail if a file would change; write nothing

  **Default** `false`
  :::
::

```bash
i18n-micro format --check
```

## Exchange

### `export`

Export locale files to PO or CSV, with the default-locale text as the source

::field-group
  :::field{name="--translationDir" type="string"}
  Translation directory, relative to the project

  **Default** `i18n.translationDir` of nuxt.config
  :::

  :::field{name="--format" type="string"}
  File format: `po`, `csv`

  **Default** `po`
  :::

  :::field{name="--dir" type="string"}
  Output directory, relative to the project

  **Default** `pots` for po, `csv_exports` for csv
  :::

  :::field{name="--force" type="boolean"}
  Overwrite files changed since the last export and never imported

  **Default** `false`
  :::
::

```bash
i18n-micro export --format csv
```

### `import`

Merge PO or CSV files into the locale files

::field-group
  :::field{name="--translationDir" type="string"}
  Translation directory, relative to the project

  **Default** `i18n.translationDir` of nuxt.config
  :::

  :::field{name="--format" type="string"}
  File format: `po`, `csv`

  **Default** `po`
  :::

  :::field{name="--dir" type="string"}
  Input directory, relative to the project

  **Default** `pots` for po, `csv_exports` for csv
  :::

  :::field{name="--dryRun" type="boolean"}
  Report what would be imported; write nothing

  **Default** `false`
  :::
::

```bash
i18n-micro import --format csv --dryRun
```

### `sync-remote`

Pull global translations from, or push them to, the HTTP endpoint in .i18n-remote.json

::field-group
  :::field{name="--translationDir" type="string"}
  Translation directory, relative to the project

  **Default** `i18n.translationDir` of nuxt.config
  :::

  :::field{name="--pull" type="boolean"}
  Pull from the remote

  **Default** `true`
  :::

  :::field{name="--push" type="boolean"}
  Push to the remote

  **Default** `false`
  :::

  :::field{name="--force" type="boolean"}
  On a pull, take the remote value; on a push, overwrite text only the remote holds

  **Default** `false`
  :::

  :::field{name="--dryRun" type="boolean"}
  Report what a pull would change; write and push nothing

  **Default** `false`
  :::
::

```bash
i18n-micro sync-remote --dryRun
i18n-micro sync-remote --no-pull --push
```

## Lint rules

::field-group
  :::field{name="no-trailing-spaces"}
  Spaces at the end of a value or a line

  Fixed by `--fix`.
  :::

  :::field{name="no-multiple-spaces"}
  Two or more spaces in a row

  Fixed by `--fix`.
  :::

  :::field{name="no-empty-translation"}
  An empty or blank value
  :::
::

## Exit codes

::field-group
  :::field{name="0"}
  Done, nothing to report
  :::

  :::field{name="1"}
  Findings: `check`, `lint` or `format --check` found something, `clean` or `sync` could not prove a removal safe, `export` would overwrite unimported work, `translate` left keys out, `import` or `sync-remote` met a conflict, a `sync-remote` push would drop remote text. A `--dryRun` of `clean`, `sync` or a `sync-remote` pull reports these and exits `0`
  :::

  :::field{name="2"}
  Failure: bad usage, unreadable project, network or file error
  :::
::

## Configuration files

::field-group
  :::field{name=".i18n-lintrc.json"}
  `lint`: `enabledRules`, `disabledRules`, `customRegexRules` (`name`, `pattern`, `flags`, `description`, `replacement`)
  :::

  :::field{name=".i18n-remote.json"}
  `sync-remote`: `url`, `path`, `token`, `auth` (`username`, `password`). `type` may be left out; only `custom` exists
  :::

  :::field{name=".i18n-glossary.json"}
  `translate --service ai`: `entries` of `source`, `target`, and optional `from`, `to`
  :::
::

## Environment variables

::field-group
  :::field{name="I18N_TRANSLATE_TOKEN"}
  API key of `translate`. Read from `.env` too
  :::

  :::field{name="I18N_REMOTE_TOKEN"}
  Bearer token of `sync-remote`. Read from `.env` too
  :::

  :::field{name="AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"}
  Key of the `ai` service, when `I18N_TRANSLATE_TOKEN` is not set
  :::

  :::field{name="DEFAULT_LOCALE"}
  Overrides `defaultLocale`, as in the module
  :::
::

## Removed commands

::field-group
  :::field{name="validate"}
  Instead: check
  :::

  :::field{name="diff"}
  Instead: check --only missing
  :::

  :::field{name="check-duplicates"}
  Instead: check --only duplicates
  :::

  :::field{name="export-csv"}
  Instead: export --format csv
  :::

  :::field{name="import-csv"}
  Instead: import --format csv
  :::

  :::field{name="estimate"}
  Instead: translate --dryRun
  :::

  :::field{name="optimize"}
  Instead: check --only duplicates
  :::

  :::field{name="backup"}
  Instead: git, which already keeps your locale files
  :::

  :::field{name="restore"}
  Instead: git, which already keeps your locale files
  :::

  :::field{name="init"}
  Instead: nuxi init, then add nuxt-i18n-micro to modules
  :::

  :::field{name="split"}
  Instead: nothing: the module does not read split files
  :::

  :::field{name="replace-values"}
  Instead: your editor or sed
  :::

  :::field{name="glossary"}
  Instead: editing .i18n-glossary.json by hand
  :::
::


# Hooks

The module calls two runtime (app) hooks. `i18n:register` adds translations that are not in your `locales/` files. `i18n:beforeLocaleSwitch` runs before the page switches to another locale, and can send it to another locale or stop it.

## `i18n:register`

```ts
'i18n:register': (
  register: (translations: unknown, locale?: string) => void,
  locale: string,
) => HookResult
```

::field-group
  :::field
  ---
  name: register
  type: "(translations: unknown, locale?: string) => void"
  ---
  Deep-merges `translations` into the page chunk of the route being loaded, for `locale` (default: the hook's `locale`). Keys already there are overridden.
  :::

  :::field{name="locale" type="string"}
  The locale of the route being loaded.
  :::
::

The hook is typed through `RuntimeNuxtHooks`, so `nuxtApp.hook('i18n:register', …)` needs no cast.

## When it fires

The loader plugin (`i18n-plugin-loader`) calls it:

1. once on startup, when every plugin has run (`app:created`) and before the app renders;
2. in its `router.beforeEach`, after the target page's translations are loaded, when the path changes — on every navigation under `no_prefix`.

Every callback and every `register` call is awaited before the app renders or the navigation goes on, so the page renders with the merged keys. With [`hooks: false`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/module-options#hooks) the hook is never called.

### Example

```ts
// plugins/i18n-extra.ts
export default defineNuxtPlugin((nuxtApp) => {
  nuxtApp.hook('i18n:register', async (register, locale) => {
    const extra = await $fetch<Record<string, unknown>>(`/api/cms-strings/${locale}`)
    register(extra, locale)
  })
})
```

This is a runtime hook: register it with `nuxtApp.hook` in a plugin, not with `nuxt.hook` in `nuxt.config` or a module's `setup`. A module adds such a plugin with `addPlugin`.

## `i18n:beforeLocaleSwitch`

```ts
'i18n:beforeLocaleSwitch': (ctx: { from: string; to: string; cancel: boolean }) => HookResult
```

::field-group
  :::field{name="from" type="string"}
  The locale the page shows now.
  :::

  :::field{name="to" type="string"}
  The locale it switches to. Set another enabled locale to switch there instead; a locale that is not enabled is ignored.
  :::

  :::field{name="cancel" type="boolean"}
  Set `true` to stay: the page, its dictionary and the stored preference do not change.
  :::
::

```ts
// plugins/confirm-locale.client.ts
export default defineNuxtPlugin((nuxtApp) => {
  nuxtApp.hook('i18n:beforeLocaleSwitch', async (ctx) => {
    if (hasUnsavedChanges() && !confirm('Leave without saving?')) ctx.cancel = true
    // a regional locale the app does not have yet
    if (ctx.to === 'de-at') ctx.to = 'de'
  })
})
```

It is called once per switch, on the client, after the first load:

- for a navigation into another locale: `$switchLocale`, `<i18n-switcher>`, a link or `router.push` to a page of another locale (prefix strategies). A cancel aborts the navigation, as a guard returning `false`; another `to` redirects to the same page in that locale, and that navigation is not asked again;
- under `no_prefix` and in hash mode, by `$switchLocale` before the dictionary loads (there the dictionary moves first, and no guard could undo it).

`$switchLocale` resolves `false` when the switch is cancelled, and `true` when the page switched, also to a locale the hook chose. A switch to a locale on another domain (`locales[].baseUrl`) leaves the app and is not asked. With nobody subscribed the hook costs one lookup per switch, and with [`hooks: false`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/module-options#hooks) it is never called.

### After a switch

There is no hook after a switch: watch the locale. A `watch` of `$getLocale()` fires once the new locale is applied, its dictionary loaded and in place:

```ts
// plugins/locale-analytics.client.ts
export default defineNuxtPlugin((nuxtApp) => {
  watch(
    () => nuxtApp.$getLocale(),
    (locale) => track('locale', locale),
  )
})
```

# API reference

This section lists every option, helper, hook, composable and component of the Nuxt module, plus the exported API of each `@i18n-micro/*` package. Use it to look up a signature or a default; the [Guide](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/guide/getting-started) explains how to use them. Most of it is generated from the source, so it matches the code.

## Nuxt module

- [Module options](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/module-options) — every `i18n` key in `nuxt.config`, with type and default
- [Helpers](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/methods) — `$t`, `$tc`, `$tn`, `$td`, `$localePath`, `$switchLocale`, `$defineI18nRoute` and the rest
- [Hooks](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/events) — the `i18n:register` and `i18n:beforeLocaleSwitch` runtime hooks

## Composables

- [`useI18n`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/composables/useI18n) — the helpers in `<script setup>`
- [`useI18nLocale`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/composables/useI18nLocale) — locale state and cookie in a custom detection plugin
- [`useI18nHead`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/composables/useI18nHead) — per-page overrides of the generated SEO tags
- [`useLocaleHead`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/composables/useLocaleHead) — the SEO tags as an object, for your own `useHead`

## Components

- [`<i18n-t>`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/components/i18n-t) — one translation, with plural, formatting and slot interpolation
- [`<i18n-link>`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/components/i18n-link) — a `NuxtLink` to the localized route
- [`<i18n-switcher>`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/components/i18n-switcher) — a locale dropdown
- [`<i18n-group>`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/components/i18n-group) — a block with a shared key prefix

## Server

Nitro handlers use `useTranslationServerMiddleware` and `useLocaleServerMiddleware`, not the client helpers. See [Server routes](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/guide/server-side-translations).

## Packages

[Package APIs](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages) lists the exports of every `@i18n-micro/*` package, one generated page each.

## Related

:card{icon="i-lucide-book-open" title="Getting started" to="https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/guide/getting-started"}

:card{icon="i-lucide-boxes" title="Framework packages" to="https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/integrations/"}
::


# Helpers

The module injects its runtime helpers into the Nuxt app: `$t`, `$tc`, `$localePath`, `$switchLocale` and the rest. Use this page to look up a helper's signature and behaviour. Signatures and descriptions come from the `PluginsInjections` and `NuxtAppOnlyInjections` interfaces in `src/runtime/plugins/01.plugin.ts`.

## Access

- **Template** — ``{v-pre=""}: every helper, with the `$`.
- **`<script setup>`** — `const { t, localePath } = useI18n()`: every helper in `PluginsInjections`, with and without the `$`.
- **Plugin, middleware, `<script setup>`** — `const { $t, $defineI18nRoute } = useNuxtApp()`: everything, `$` only.

`$defineI18nRoute` is typed on `useNuxtApp()` only. See [`useI18n`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/composables/useI18n).

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const { t, localePath } = useI18n()
</script>

<template>
  <NuxtLink :to="localePath('/about')">{{ t('nav.about') }}</NuxtLink>
</template>
```

- [`$_t`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#_t) — Bind `$t` to a specific route, for translating outside the current page — a layout rendering a link to another route, for example.
- [`$_ts`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#_ts) — Bind `$ts` to a specific route.
- [`$clearCache`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#clearcache) — Drop every cached translation chunk and reload the current page's dictionary.
- [`$defaultLocale`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#defaultlocale) — Code of the configured default locale.
- [`$getI18nConfig`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#geti18nconfig) — The resolved module configuration, as the runtime sees it.
- [`$getLocale`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#getlocale) — Code of the active locale.
- [`$getLocaleName`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#getlocalename) — The active locale's `displayName` from the config, or `null` when it has none.
- [`$getLocales`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#getlocales) — Every configured locale, with its metadata.
- [`$getRouteName`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#getroutename) — Route name with the locale prefix stripped — the name translations are keyed by.
- [`$has`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#has) — Whether a key resolves in the active locale.
- `$i18nStrategy` — The active routing strategy, resolving locales to and from paths.
- [`$loadPageTranslations`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#loadpagetranslations) — Load translations for a page at runtime, for content whose keys are not known at build time.
- [`$localePath`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#localepath) — Resolve a path in the given locale, or the active one.
- [`$localeRoute`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#localeroute) — Resolve a route in the given locale, or the active one.
- [`$mergeTranslations`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#mergetranslations) — Merge translations into the active locale at runtime, overriding what is loaded.
- `$pluralFunc` — The plural rule `$tc` uses: `<i18n-t>` asks for it to pick a form from the raw translation.
- `$pluralLocale` — The tag `$tc` plurals by: the locale's `iso` when it has one, else its code.
- [`$resolveTranslations`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#resolvetranslations) — Every translation currently in memory for the active locale and route, as a tree.
- [`$setI18nRouteParams`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#seti18nrouteparams) — Set per-locale params for the current route, so a dynamic segment can differ per language.
- [`$setMissingHandler`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#setmissinghandler) — Install a callback invoked for every unresolved key.
- [`$setTranslation`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#settranslation) — Replace the value at `key` in the active dictionary.
- [`$switchLocale`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#switchlocale) — Navigate to the current page in another locale.
- [`$switchLocalePath`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#switchlocalepath) — The path of the current page in another locale, without navigating.
- [`$switchLocaleRoute`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#switchlocaleroute) — The route object for the current page in another locale, without navigating, or a URL string for a locale on its own `baseUrl`.
- [`$switchRoute`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#switchroute) — Navigate to another route, keeping the active locale or switching to `toLocale`.
- [`$t`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#t) — Translate a key, interpolating `params` into it.
- [`$tc`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#tc) — Translate with pluralization.
- [`$td`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#td) — Format a date with `Intl.DateTimeFormat` in the active locale.
- [`$tdr`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#tdr) — Format a date as relative time ("3 days ago") with `Intl.RelativeTimeFormat`.
- [`$tn`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#tn) — Format a number with `Intl.NumberFormat` in the active locale.
- [`$ts`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#ts) — Like `$t`, but always returns a string: the value goes through `toString()`, so a nested object becomes `'[object Object]'`.

## Locale

### `$getLocale`

```ts
(route?: RouteLocationNormalizedLoaded | RouteLocationResolvedGeneric) => string
```

Code of the active locale. Pass a route to read the locale that route belongs to.

```ts
$getLocale() // 'de' on /de/about
```

### `$getLocaleName`

```ts
() => string | null
```

The active locale's `displayName` from the config, or `null` when it has none.

### `$getLocales`

```ts
() => Locale[]
```

Every configured locale, with its metadata.

Custom properties on a locale object come back as written; type them with [module augmentation](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/module-options#locales) of `Locale`.

### `$defaultLocale`

```ts
() => string | undefined
```

Code of the configured default locale.

### `$getI18nConfig`

```ts
() => ResolvedI18nConfig
```

The resolved module configuration, as the runtime sees it.

The value includes [runtime overrides](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/guide/runtime-overrides) (`defaultLocale`, `fallbackLocale`, disabled locales).

```ts
const { strategy, localeCookie } = useNuxtApp().$getI18nConfig()
```

## Translation

### `$t`

```ts
TranslationFn<CleanTranslation>
```

Translate a key, interpolating `params` into it. Returns `defaultValue` when the key is
missing, or the key itself when no default is given.

```ts
// { "welcome": "Welcome, {name}!" }
$t('welcome', { name: 'Ada' }) // 'Welcome, Ada!'
$t('missing.key', {}, 'Fallback') // 'Fallback'
```

A key that points at a nested object returns that object, not a string. In a template it renders as `[object Object]`; use a leaf key.

### `$ts`

```ts
TranslationFn<string>
```

Like `$t`, but always returns a string: the value goes through `toString()`, so a nested
object becomes `'[object Object]'`. Point the key at a leaf.

### `$_t`

```ts
(route: RouteLocationNormalizedLoaded) => TranslationFn<CleanTranslation>
```

Bind `$t` to a specific route, for translating outside the current page — a layout rendering
a link to another route, for example.

```ts
const route = useRoute()
const t = useNuxtApp().$_t(route)
t('page.title')
```

### `$_ts`

```ts
(route: RouteLocationNormalizedLoaded) => TranslationFn<string>
```

Bind `$ts` to a specific route. See `$_t`.

### `$tc`

```ts
(key: TranslationKey, params: number | Params, defaultValue?: string) => string
```

Translate with pluralization. `params` may be the count itself, or an object containing
`count`.

Forms are separated by `|`. With the built-in rule a non-negative integer count `n` picks form `n`, clamped to the last form; a negative, fractional or `NaN` count takes the last form. `{count}` and the other params are interpolated into the picked form.

For languages whose plurals do not follow the count, start the template with `=0 `. The first form is then for 0, and the others go by [`Intl.PluralRules`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Intl/PluralRules){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"} category, in the order `zero, one, two, few, many, other`:

```json
{
  "apples": "=0 no apples | one apple | {count} apples",
  "files": "=0 no files | {count} one | {count} few | {count} many"
}
```

```ts
$tc('apples', 0) // 'no apples'
$tc('apples', 1) // 'one apple'
$tc('apples', 7) // '7 apples'

// In `uk` (categories `one, few, many, other`) the forms after the zero form follow those categories:
$tc('files', 21) // '21 one'
$tc('files', 22) // '22 few'
$tc('files', 25) // '25 many'
$tc('files', 2.5) // '2.5 many': no form for `other`, so the last one
```

- `=0 `counts only at the very start of the value, with the space. `$t` shows it as text: it belongs to plurals.
- A category with no form of its own takes the last form. A negative or fractional count takes the last form too.
- It works in any locale: `=0 none | one | {count} many` in English.
- The category comes from the locale's `iso`, else its code. A code `Intl` does not know falls back to the index rule, the marker still removed, so the result never depends on the machine.
- `<i18n-t :plural>` follows the same rule. A custom [`plural`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/module-options#plural) or `customPluralRule` gets the raw value, marker included, and decides for itself; `plural` returning `null` hands the call back to the built-in rule, which honours the marker.

Without the marker a template stays on the index rule, with one exception that only reads one way: a zero form with no placeholder, then one form per category, with `{count}` in each form several counts share (`no files | {count} one | {count} few | {count} many` in `uk`).

For rules of your own set [`plural`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/module-options#plural).

```ts
// { "apples": "no apples | one apple | {count} apples" }
$tc('apples', 0) // 'no apples'
$tc('apples', 10) // '10 apples'
$tc('cart', { count: 2, name: 'Ada' }) // count and params in one object
```

The third argument is `defaultValue`, not params.

### `$has`

```ts
(key: string) => boolean
```

Whether a key resolves in the active locale. Use it to branch on optional copy instead of
rendering a raw key. Like `$t`, it also sees the leaving page's keys during a same-locale
page transition.

```ts
if ($has('promo.banner')) show.value = true
```

## Formatting

### `$tn`

```ts
{ (value: number, options?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions): string (value: number, key: string, overrides?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions): string (value: number, key: string, locale: string, overrides?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions): string }
```

Format a number with `Intl.NumberFormat` in the active locale. A key selects a named format
from the config.

Named formats come from [`numberFormats`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/module-options#numberformats).

```ts
$tn(1234.5, { style: 'currency', currency: 'EUR' }) // '1.234,50 €' in de
$tn(1000, 'currency') // named format
$tn(1000, 'currency', 'de') // named format in another locale
```

### `$td`

```ts
{ (value: Date | number | string, options?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions): string (value: Date | number | string, key: string, overrides?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions): string (value: Date | number | string, key: string, locale: string, overrides?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions): string }
```

Format a date with `Intl.DateTimeFormat` in the active locale. A key selects a named format
from the config.

Named formats come from [`datetimeFormats`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/module-options#datetimeformats).

```ts
$td(new Date(), { dateStyle: 'long' })
$td(post.createdAt, 'short')
```

### `$tdr`

```ts
(value: Date | number | string, options?: Intl.RelativeTimeFormatOptions) => string
```

Format a date as relative time ("3 days ago") with `Intl.RelativeTimeFormat`.

```ts
$tdr(Date.now() - 5 * 60_000) // '5 minutes ago' in en
```

## Switching and links

### `$switchLocale`

```ts
(locale: string) => Promise<boolean>
```

Navigate to the current page in another locale. Under `no_prefix` and hash mode it loads the
locale's translations before navigating; under `no_prefix` the route is replaced in place (no
new history entry). An unknown locale is ignored.
The call is async: `await` it to run code after the navigation. It resolves `true` when the
locale's dictionary is active, `false` when it is not: the chunk failed to load (the current
dictionary stays; call it again to retry) or a newer switch won.

```ts
await $switchLocale('de')
```

### `$switchLocalePath`

```ts
(locale: string) => string
```

The path of the current page in another locale, without navigating.

```vue
<NuxtLink :to="$switchLocalePath('de')">Deutsch</NuxtLink>
```

### `$switchLocaleRoute`

```ts
(locale: string) => RouteLocationRaw
```

The route object for the current page in another locale, without navigating, or a URL string
for a locale on its own `baseUrl`. Under `trailingSlash` the object has `path` and `fullPath`,
following the rule, with the `query` and `hash` as they are, and `router.push` or a link keeps them.

### `$switchRoute`

```ts
(route: RouteLocationNamedRaw | RouteLocationResolvedGeneric | string, toLocale?: string) => Promise<void>
```

Navigate to another route, keeping the active locale or switching to `toLocale`. Async like
`$switchLocale`.

```ts
$switchRoute('/about') // active locale
$switchRoute({ name: 'about' }, 'de') // switch to de
```

### `$localePath`

```ts
(to: RouteLocationNamedRaw | RouteLocationResolvedGeneric | string, locale?: string) => string
```

Resolve a path in the given locale, or the active one. A string with an `http(s):`, `mailto:`
or `tel:` scheme comes back as is: do not pass user input as a link target unchecked.

A string path is read as the page it shows, so a locale's custom path is applied too.

```ts
$localePath('/about') // '/about' in en, '/de/ueber-uns' in de with localeRoutes
$localePath({ name: 'about' }, 'fr') // '/fr/about'
```

### `$localeRoute`

```ts
(to: RouteLocationNamedRaw | RouteLocationResolvedGeneric | string, locale?: string) => RouteLocationResolved
```

Resolve a route in the given locale, or the active one. A plain object, safe to keep in state. When a param needs
escaping it has `path`, `fullPath`, `query` and `hash` but no `name` or `params`: the path is what gives the router
the encoded URL. For a locale on another domain `path` and `fullPath` are absolute, which the router cannot take:
such a link goes through `<i18n-link>`, or `$localePath`.

### `$getRouteName`

```ts
(route?: RouteLocationNormalizedLoaded | RouteLocationResolvedGeneric, locale?: string) => string
```

Route name with the locale prefix stripped — the name translations are keyed by.

```ts
$getRouteName() // 'about' on /de/about
```

## Page config

### `$defineI18nRoute`

```ts
(routeDefinition: DefineI18nRouteConfig | false) => Promise<void>
```

Register per-page locale configuration and translations from inside a component.
Merges into the active locale and re-applies when the locale changes.

Call it in a page's `<script setup>`, always destructured from `useNuxtApp()`. The build reads `locales`, `localeRoutes` and `disableMeta` from the call; at runtime only `locales` matters (inline translations are merged for the active locale). Full rules: [Page config](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/guide/per-component-translations).

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const { $defineI18nRoute } = useNuxtApp()

$defineI18nRoute({
  locales: ['en', 'de'],
  localeRoutes: { en: '/about', de: '/ueber-uns' },
})
</script>
```

### `$setI18nRouteParams`

```ts
(value: I18nRouteParams) => I18nRouteParams
```

Set per-locale params for the current route, so a dynamic segment can differ per language.
Call it during SSR, before the head is rendered.

The params are cleared when a navigation to another path commits, including `/news/1` to `/news/4`, which keeps the route name. Details: [Localized paths](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/guide/custom-locale-routes).

```ts
$setI18nRouteParams({
  en: { slug: 'my-post' },
  de: { slug: 'mein-beitrag' },
})
```

## Runtime translations

### `$mergeTranslations`

```ts
(newTranslations: Translations) => void
```

Merge translations into the active locale at runtime, overriding what is loaded.

Deep-merges into the active locale's current page chunk; keys it does not mention survive.

```ts
$mergeTranslations({ banner: { title: 'Sale' } })
```

### `$setTranslation`

```ts
(key: string, value: unknown) => void
```

Replace the value at `key` in the active dictionary. This is a replace, not a merge —
use `$mergeTranslations` when existing siblings should survive.

```ts
$setTranslation('banner', { title: 'Sale' }) // drops other keys under banner
$setTranslation('banner.title', 'Sale') // dotted path
```

### `$loadPageTranslations`

```ts
(locale: string, routeName: string, translations: Translations) => Promise<void>
```

Load translations for a page at runtime, for content whose keys are not known at build time.

Merges into the in-memory `(locale, routeName)` chunk, and the screen updates when that chunk is active. No payload is fetched here: for a page not loaded yet the translations wait, and when its file loads they stay on top of it.

```ts
await $loadPageTranslations('en', 'about', { title: 'About us' })
```

### `$resolveTranslations`

```ts
() => Translations
```

Every translation currently in memory for the active locale and route, as a tree.
Read-only view of what `$t()` can resolve right now.

Treat the result as read-only.

### `$setMissingHandler`

```ts
(handler: MissingHandler | null) => void
```

Install a callback invoked for every unresolved key. Pass `null` to remove it.

The handler runs instead of the dev warning.

```ts
$setMissingHandler((locale, key, routeName) => {
  console.error(`[i18n] missing ${key} in ${locale} (${routeName})`)
})
```

### `$clearCache`

```ts
() => void
```

Drop every cached translation chunk and reload the current page's dictionary. The page
keeps showing its current translations until the fresh ones arrive. Dev HMR calls it on
every translation file change.

```ts
const { clearCache } = useI18n()
clearCache()
```

A failed reload keeps the current dictionary.

# Module options

This page lists every key of the `i18n` object in `nuxt.config`. Each option has a section below with its type, default, what it does and, where it helps, an example; the index right after the example links to them by group. Types, defaults and descriptions are generated from the `ModuleOptions` interface in [`packages/types/src/index.ts`](https://github.com/s00d/nuxt-i18n-micro/blob/main/packages/types/src/index.ts){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"}.

```ts [nuxt.config.ts]
export default defineNuxtConfig({
  modules: ['nuxt-i18n-micro'],
  i18n: {
    locales: [
      { code: 'en', iso: 'en-US', displayName: 'English' },
      { code: 'de', iso: 'de-DE', displayName: 'Deutsch' },
    ],
    defaultLocale: 'en',
  },
})
```

A nested option appears under its dotted path: `translationPayloads.mode` is the `mode` key of `translationPayloads`.

- [Locales and URLs](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#locales-and-urls) — [`locales`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#locales) · [`defaultLocale`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#defaultlocale) · [`strategy`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#strategy) · [`globalLocaleRoutes`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#globallocaleroutes) · [`routeLocales`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#routelocales) · [`routeDisableMeta`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#routedisablemeta) · [`customRegexMatcher`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#customregexmatcher) · [`excludePatterns`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#excludepatterns) · [`localizedRouteNamePrefix`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#localizedroutenameprefix) · [`trailingSlash`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#trailingslash)
- [Translations](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#translations) — [`translationDir`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#translationdir) · [`additionalTranslationDirs`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#additionaltranslationdirs) · [`disablePageLocales`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#disablepagelocales) · [`fallbackLocale`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#fallbacklocale) · [`linkedMessages`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#linkedmessages) · [`routesLocaleLinks`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#routeslocalelinks) · [`plural`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#plural) · [`numberFormats`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#numberformats) · [`datetimeFormats`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#datetimeformats) · [`timeZone`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#timezone) · [`disableWatcher`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#disablewatcher) · [`missingWarn`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#missingwarn)

- [SEO](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#seo) — [`meta`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#meta) · [`metaBaseUrl`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#metabaseurl) · [`metaTrustForwardedHost`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#metatrustforwardedhost) · [`metaTrustForwardedProto`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#metatrustforwardedproto) · [`trustForwardedHost`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#trustforwardedhost) · [`hreflangBaseLanguage`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#hreflangbaselanguage) · [`canonicalQueryWhitelist`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#canonicalquerywhitelist)
- [Detection and redirects](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#detection-and-redirects) — [`redirects`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#redirects) · [`redirectStatusCode`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#redirectstatuscode) · [`autoDetectLanguage`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#autodetectlanguage) · [`autoDetectPath`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#autodetectpath) · [`localeCookie`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#localecookie) · [`localeCookieOptions`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#localecookieoptions) · [`noPrefixRedirect`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#noprefixredirect) · [`prefixCaseRedirect`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#prefixcaseredirect)
- [Registration and development](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#registration-and-development) — [`plugin`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#plugin) · [`define`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#define) · [`hooks`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#hooks) · [`components`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#components) · [`types`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#types) · [`hmr`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#hmr) · [`debug`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#debug) · [`vueDevtools`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#vuedevtools) · [`experimental`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#experimental)

## Locales and URLs

### `locales`

**Type** `Locale[]` · **Default** `[]`

List of supported locales.
Each entry defines a locale code plus optional metadata (ISO, direction, display name, etc.).

Each entry is a `Locale` object:

::field-group
  :::field{required name="code" type="string"}
  URL segment and file name (`en`, `de-at`).
  :::

  :::field{name="iso" type="string"}
  BCP-47 tag for `<html lang>`, `hreflang`, plurals and `$tn` / `$td` / `$tdr` (`en-US`).
  :::

  :::field{name="displayName" type="string"}
  Label in `<i18n-switcher>` and `$getLocaleName()`.
  :::

  :::field{name="dir" type="'ltr' | 'rtl' | 'auto'"}
  `<html dir>`. Without it, known RTL languages get `rtl` and every other locale gets no attribute. See [SEO](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/guide/seo#text-direction).
  :::

  :::field{name="disabled" type="boolean"}
  Excluded from routes, payloads and switching. Its prefix is a 404, and links to it stay on the page.
  :::

  :::field{name="fallbackLocale" type="string"}
  Fallback for this locale; overrides the global `fallbackLocale`.
  :::

  :::field{name="seo" type="boolean"}
  `false` leaves the locale out of `hreflang` and `og:locale:alternate`.
  :::

  :::field{name="og" type="string"}
  `og:locale` value (`ar_AE`); default: `iso` converted.
  :::

  :::field{name="baseUrl" type="string"}
  The locale's own domain: one build serves it, and links into it from other domains are absolute.
  :::

  :::field{name="baseDefault" type="boolean"}
  With `baseUrl`: the default locale of its host, with no `/<code>` prefix in links to it (`prefix` keeps it).
  :::
::

Other properties are kept and returned by `$getLocales()`. Type them by augmenting `Locale`:

```ts
// i18n.d.ts
declare module '@i18n-micro/types' {
  interface Locale {
    flag?: string
  }
}
export {}
```

The module hoists `@i18n-micro/types`, so this works under pnpm without installing the package.

### `defaultLocale`

**Type** `string` · **Default** `'en'`

The locale to use when no locale can be determined from URL or user preferences.
It is not a translation fallback: set `fallbackLocale` for that.

### `strategy`

**Type** `Strategies` · **Default** `'prefix_except_default'`

URL routing strategy for locale prefixes.

- `'no_prefix'` — no locale in URL; locale stored in cookie.
- `'prefix_except_default'` — prefix all locales except the default.
- `'prefix'` — always prefix, including the default locale.
- `'prefix_and_default'` — like `prefix`, but the default locale is also accessible without prefix.

URLs per strategy and redirects: [Routing strategies](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/guide/strategy).

### `globalLocaleRoutes`

**Type** `GlobalLocaleRoutes` · **Default** `{}`

Global route-level locale configuration.
Allows restricting or customizing locale routes for specific pages without
modifying their components.

- `false` — exclude the route from localization.
- `Record<LocaleCode, string>` — custom per-locale paths.

Keys are route names or paths. Usually set per page with [`$defineI18nRoute`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/guide/per-component-translations).

```ts
globalLocaleRoutes: {
  about: { en: '/about-us', de: '/ueber-uns' },
  'admin-dashboard': false, // not localized
}
```

Details, dynamic segments and `pages:extend` routes: [Localized paths](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/guide/custom-locale-routes).

### `routeLocales`

**Type** `Record<string, string[]>` · **Default** —

Per-route locale restrictions, extracted at build time from `$defineI18nRoute()` calls.
Maps a route path (e.g. `'/about'`) to an array of allowed locale codes.
Routes not listed have no restrictions (all locales allowed).

### `routeDisableMeta`

**Type** `Record<string, boolean | string[]>` · **Default** —

Per-route meta tag disabling. Maps a route name or path to `true` (disable all meta) or an array
of locale codes for which meta should be disabled. Entries found in `$defineI18nRoute()`
calls at build time are added to it.

### `customRegexMatcher`

**Type** `string | RegExp` · **Default** `undefined (uses built-in pattern based on locale codes)`

Custom regular expression (or its string source) for matching locale codes in URL segments.
Every locale code in `locales` must match the whole pattern, without its flags, or the build fails.

```ts
customRegexMatcher: '[a-z]{2}-[a-z]{2}', // en-us, de-at
```

### `excludePatterns`

**Type** `(string | RegExp)[]` · **Default** `undefined`

Paths to leave out of i18n routing: a string is a path prefix (`/admin` covers `/admin/x`)
or a `*` / `?` glob; a RegExp is tested against the path. Matching pages get no locale
variants, no locale redirect or 404, and are dropped from prerender; they still render with
translations. `/api`, `/_nuxt`, `/__*`, the translations route and common static files
(sitemap, robots.txt, favicon, assets by extension) are always excluded.

```ts
excludePatterns: ['/admin', '/docs/*', /^\/preview\//],
```

More: [Excluding paths](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/guide/excluding-static-files).

### `localizedRouteNamePrefix`

**Type** `string` · **Default** `'localized-'`

Prefix prepended to localized route names (e.g. `'localized-index'`).
Used internally to distinguish original routes from generated locale variants.

### `trailingSlash`

**Type** `'append' | 'remove'` · **Default** `undefined (inherit from Nuxt)`

Trailing slash for `$localePath` / `$switchLocalePath` (NuxtLink parity).
Defaults to `experimental.defaults.nuxtLink.trailingSlash` when unset.
Set explicitly to override Nuxt's link default for i18n path helpers.

## Translations

### `translationDir`

**Type** `string` · **Default** `'locales'`

Path to the directory containing translation JSON files, relative to the project root.

Relative to each layer's root, not to `app/` (`'app/locales'` for a Nuxt 4 layout). File layout: [Translation files](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/guide/translations).

### `additionalTranslationDirs`

**Type** `string[]` · **Default** `[]`

Extra directories whose top-level `{locale}.json` files are deep-merged into the global
dictionary before `translationDir`. A relative path is read in the project root and in each
Nuxt layer root; an absolute path (a Nuxt module's own folder) is read once.

Merge order: each entry in array order (across layers), then `translationDir` (wins on conflicts).
Only root `{locale}.json` files are read — `pages/` under these dirs is ignored.
Entries other modules add to `nuxt.options.i18n.additionalTranslationDirs` count, whatever their order.

Example: `translationDir: 'frontend'`, `additionalTranslationDirs: ['common']` → `common/en.json` then `frontend/en.json`.

A Nuxt module can ship translations of its own: it adds its folder by absolute path, listed before or after `nuxt-i18n-micro`. The folder is read once (not per layer), its files are part of the payload fingerprint (`?v=`), and in dev they hot-reload like the app's.

```ts [my-module/src/module.ts]
import { createResolver, defineNuxtModule } from '@nuxt/kit'

export default defineNuxtModule({
  meta: { name: 'my-module' },
  setup(_options, nuxt) {
    const { resolve } = createResolver(import.meta.url)
    const i18n = ((nuxt.options as { i18n?: { additionalTranslationDirs?: string[] } }).i18n ??= {})
    ;(i18n.additionalTranslationDirs ??= []).push(resolve('./runtime/locales'))
  },
})
```

The module's `runtime/locales/en.json` then sits under the app's files: an app key with the same name wins.

### `disablePageLocales`

**Type** `boolean` · **Default** `false`

Disable per-page translation files.
When `true`, only global translations (`{locale}.json`) are loaded;
page-specific files (`pages/{page}/{locale}.json`) are not generated or loaded.

### `fallbackLocale`

**Type** `string` · **Default** `undefined (no fallback; returns the raw key)`

Global fallback locale code.
Keys missing in a locale are taken from this locale (merged into each payload when it is
built or loaded); without it a missing key renders as the key itself.

### `linkedMessages`

**Type** `boolean` · **Default** `false`

Resolve linked messages (`@:key`, `@.upper:key`, `@.lower:key`, `@.capitalize:key`, `@:{'key'}`)
in each built dictionary, so the runtime never parses them. A link to a missing key, or a
cycle, leaves the message as written and warns at build. Translations added at runtime
(`$mergeTranslations`, `i18n:register`, inline `$defineI18nRoute`) are not resolved.
Off by default: `@:` may already be plain text in your messages.

Syntax and limits: [Linked messages](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/guide/translations#linked-messages).

### `routesLocaleLinks`

**Type** `{ [key: string]: string }` · **Default** `{}`

Map route names to other route names to share the same translation files.
For example, `{ 'about-us': 'about' }` means the `about-us` page will use
translations from the `about` page instead of its own.

```ts
routesLocaleLinks: { 'products-id': 'products' },
```

### `plural`

**Type** `PluralFunc` · **Default** ``built-in pluralization (a non-negative integer count picks the form at that index, clamped to the last; negative, fractional and `NaN` counts take the last; `=0 ` opens a template of `Intl.PluralRules` categories)``

Custom pluralization function.
Receives `(key, count, params, locale, getter)` and should return the selected
plural form as a string, or `null`/`undefined` to fall back to the built-in
`defaultPlural` logic (so you can override only some locales).

For the Nuxt module the function is serialized with `.toString()` into
`.nuxt/i18n.plural.mjs` — it must be self-contained (no imports / outer scope).
A file path string is **not** supported.

The built-in rule and its `=0 `marker are described at [`$tc`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/methods#tc). Your function replaces it for what it answers, gets the raw value with any marker in place, and `null` hands the call back to it. The function receives `(key, count, params, locale, getter)`; `getter(key)` returns the raw string with all forms. Write it as a self-contained `function` or arrow expression (no method shorthand, no imports, no outer variables):

```ts
plural: function (key, count, params, locale, getter) {
  if (!locale.startsWith('en')) return null // built-in rule for other locales
  const forms = String(getter(key) ?? '').split('|').map((form) => form.trim())
  const index = count === 0 ? 0 : count === 1 ? 1 : 2
  return (forms[Math.min(index, forms.length - 1)] ?? '').replace('{count}', String(count))
},
```

```json
{ "apples": "no apples | one apple | {count} apples" }
```

### `numberFormats`

**Type** `Record<string, Record<string, Intl.NumberFormatOptions>>` · **Default** —

Named number formats per locale (Vue I18n-compatible).
Enables `$tn(1000, 'currency')` style calls.

```ts
numberFormats: {
  en: { currency: { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD' } },
  de: { currency: { style: 'currency', currency: 'EUR' } },
}
```

Used by [`$tn`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/methods#tn).

### `datetimeFormats`

**Type** `Record<string, Record<string, Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions>>` · **Default** —

Named datetime formats per locale (Vue I18n-compatible `datetimeFormats`).
Enables `$td(date, 'short')` style calls.

```ts
datetimeFormats: {
  en: { short: { year: 'numeric', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' } },
  de: { short: { year: 'numeric', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' } },
}
```

Used by [`$td`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/methods#td).

### `timeZone`

**Type** `string` · **Default** `the runtime's zone`

IANA time zone for `$td` and `<i18n-t date>` (`Europe/Berlin`). Set it to render one date on
the server and in every browser; a named format's own `timeZone` wins.

### `disableWatcher`

**Type** `boolean` · **Default** `false`

Disable the file watcher that auto-creates missing translation files in development mode.

### `missingWarn`

**Type** `boolean` · **Default** `true`

Show console warnings when a translation key is missing (development build, in the browser).

To report missing keys instead, use [`$setMissingHandler`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/methods#setmissinghandler).

## Payloads and caching

### `translationPayloads`

**Type** `TranslationPayloadOptions` · **Default** —

Controls how translation payloads are emitted (Node server: `public/<apiBaseUrl>`; Edge / function / inline: Nitro `serverAssets`).

- **Node server** (`node-server`, `node-cluster`, disk `serveStatic`): `serverAssets` means local SSR via `readFile` under `public/` (no Rollup `raw:`).
- **Edge, function presets, and `serveStatic: "inline"`** (`vercel`, `netlify`, `aws-lambda`, winterjs, …): `serverAssets` registers Nitro `serverAssets` (`assets:i18n`),
  because `public/` is not available to SSR on disk. Does not force a public copy — set `publicAssets: true` for CDN/static.

Keep the defaults for the usual all-in-one setup. For large Edge catalogs prefer `mode: 'source'`.
For CDN-backed deployments, disable local outputs and set `apiBaseClientHost` / `apiBaseServerHost`.

::field-group
  :::field{name="mode" type="'premerged' | 'source'"}
  **Default** `'premerged'` · Translation payload strategy.

  - `premerged`: build-time `{page}/{locale}/data.json` matrix (default)
  - `source`: compact source files merged at runtime (prefer on Edge / large catalogs)
  :::

  :::field{name="serverAssets" type="boolean"}
  **Default** `true` · Local SSR payloads: a Node server that serves `public/` from disk reads that tree (forces public copy);
  Edge, function presets, and `serveStatic: "inline"` embed via Nitro `serverAssets`.

  - **Node server** (preset serves `public/` itself, e.g. `node-server`): no Nitro `serverAssets` (avoids Rollup `raw:`). SSR reads
    `public/<apiBaseUrl|publicDir>` as `{page}/{locale}/data.json`; when this is `true`,
    a public copy is forced even if `publicAssets` is false.
  - **Edge, function presets, and inline** (`nitro.node === false`, no disk `serveStatic` such as `vercel` /
    `netlify` / `aws-lambda`, or `serveStatic: "inline"` e.g. winterjs): Nitro `serverAssets` (`assets:i18n`)
    with the same layout as `mode`. Does **not** force a public copy — set `publicAssets: true` for CDN/static.
  :::

  :::field{name="serverHandler" type="boolean"}
  **Default** `true` · Register the built-in server route at `/{apiBaseUrl}/:page/:locale/data.json`.
  Disable this when translation payloads are served from an external host/CDN.
  :::

  :::field{name="publicAssets" type="boolean"}
  **Default** `true in premerged mode, false in source mode` · Copy payloads into Nitro public output. Premerged → `{page}/{locale}/data.json` under `apiBaseUrl`; source → compact tree. When SSR reads `public/` (`node-server` and similar), `serverAssets: true` also forces this copy.
  On Edge / function / `serveStatic: "inline"` presets, copy only when this is `true` (SSR uses the Nitro embed).
  :::

  :::field{name="prerenderRoutes" type="boolean"}
  **Default** `false` · Opt in to Nitro-prerender `/{apiBaseUrl}/.../data.json`. Usually redundant when premerged `publicAssets` already wrote those files.
  :::

  :::field{name="publicDir" type="string"}
  Public output folder relative to Nitro public root. Defaults to `apiBaseUrl` (`_locales`). So static files match client fetch URLs (`/{apiBaseUrl}/{page}/{locale}/data.json`).
  :::

  :::field{name="rootDelta" type="boolean"}
  **Default** `true` · Write one root file per locale, and in each page file only what differs from it. The client and SSR merge them;
  a whole chunk still works wherever a file is read. `false` keeps a whole dictionary in every page file.
  `premerged` only, and off with `disablePageLocales`.
  :::

  :::field{name="warnFileCount" type="number"}
  **Default** `500` · Warn during build when generated payload file count exceeds this threshold.
  :::

  :::field{name="warnSizeBytes" type="number"}
  **Default** `10485760 (10 MB)` · Warn during build when generated payload total size exceeds this threshold in bytes.
  :::
::

Which combination of these keys fits Node, serverless, Edge, static hosting or a CDN: [Deployment](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/guide/deployment).

### `apiBaseUrl`

**Type** `string` · **Default** `'_locales'`

Base URL path segment for the translations API route (used in SSR/SSG data fetching).
Can also be set via `NUXT_I18N_APP_BASE_URL` environment variable.

Payload URLs are `/{apiBaseUrl}/{page}/{locale}/data.json`.

### `apiBaseClientHost`

**Type** `string` · **Default** `undefined`

Override the host used for client-side translation fetch requests.
Useful when the client reaches the server via a different hostname than the one Nuxt sees.
Can also be set via `NUXT_I18N_APP_BASE_CLIENT_HOST` environment variable.

### `apiBaseServerHost`

**Type** `string` · **Default** `undefined`

Override the host used for server-side translation fetch requests.
Useful in container/microservice setups where the server reaches itself via an internal hostname.
Can also be set via `NUXT_I18N_APP_BASE_SERVER_HOST` environment variable.

A host must serve the same `/{apiBaseUrl}/{page}/{locale}/data.json` responses as the built-in route.

### `dateBuild`

**Type** `string | number` · **Default** —

Value used for cache-busting translation requests (`?v=...`).

When not provided, the module uses a hash of the translation files, so the value changes
only when translations do (`Date.now()` when no hash can be computed). `0` or `''` turns
cache-busting off. Set a stable value (a git SHA, a build number) to pin it yourself.
`NUXT_I18N_DATE_BUILD` or `runtimeConfig.public.i18nRuntime.dateBuild` replaces it at runtime, after a dictionary
was replaced in place: pinned URLs are left behind, with no rebuild.

```ts
i18n: { dateBuild: 'e3b0c442' }
```

### `httpCacheDuration`

**Type** `number` · **Default** `31536000`

HTTP `Cache-Control` max-age (seconds) for `/{apiBaseUrl}/:page/:locale/data.json`.

Applies in full only while `dateBuild` busts the URL (`?v=...`), which is the default:
the response is then `private, max-age=…, immutable`: a browser pins it, and a CDN that ignores the query cannot
(`public` with `httpCacheControl: false`).

- `dateBuild: 0`/`''` — the URL is stable, so this duration is *not* honoured; the
  response becomes `public, max-age=0, must-revalidate` instead. A long `max-age` on an
  unchanging URL pins the first payload a browser ever saw.
- `0` — do not set `Cache-Control` at all (useful in local debugging)
- Not applied in development (`import.meta.dev`) so HMR is not fought by the browser cache
- Reaches only responses served through Nitro. Payloads copied into `public/` and served
  by the hosting platform take that platform's headers — see the Performance guide.

Analogous to `@nuxtjs/i18n` experimental `httpCacheDuration` (v10.2.0), but as an
explicit response header rather than Nitro `defineCachedEventHandler` maxAge.

### `cacheMaxSize`

**Type** `number` · **Default** `0`

Maximum number of entries in the in-memory translation caches. The fetch and server caches
drop the least recently used entry; the browser's dictionary map drops the oldest one (FIFO).
`0` means no limit in the browser; server caches keep at most 1000 entries then, so request
URLs naming made-up pages cannot grow server memory.

### `cacheTtl`

**Type** `number` · **Default** `0`

Time-to-live (in seconds) of the fetch and server translation caches, counted from when an
entry was stored (reads do not extend it), so data from `apiBaseServerHost` is refreshed at
least that often. The browser's active dictionaries are not expired by it. `0` means entries
never expire.

What both change at runtime: [Performance](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/guide/performance).

### `serverTranslationPreload`

**Type** `boolean` · **Default** `false`

Preload index-page translations in Nitro global middleware (server-only, private config).

### `cacheStorage`

**Type** `string` · **Default** —

Name of a Nitro storage mount (`nitro.storage`, e.g. `'redis'`) that several server instances
share as a dictionary cache, read after the in-process cache and before the source. Pays off
mostly with `apiBaseServerHost`: one fetch from the backend instead of one per instance.
Entries are keyed by build and expire after `cacheTtl`, or after one day when it is `0`.
Off in dev and prerender. A failing storage falls back to the source. Unset: no shared cache.

### `httpCacheControl`

**Type** `string | false` · **Default** `'public, max-age=60'`

`Cache-Control` of a payload file answered by a host or by a path-wide rule, which cannot see `?v=`.
On a Node server a response to the current `?v=` is pinned for `httpCacheDuration` and any other revalidates;
with `source`, `cacheTtl` or `apiBaseServerHost`, where a dictionary changes with no build, every response takes this header.
`false` keeps every file on `max-age=0, must-revalidate`.

## SEO

### `meta`

**Type** `boolean` · **Default** `true`

Generate SEO meta tags (`hreflang`, `canonical`, `og:url`, `og:locale`) automatically.

Per-page overrides: [`useI18nHead`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/composables/useI18nHead). Everything else: [SEO](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/guide/seo).

### `metaBaseUrl`

**Type** `string` · **Default** `undefined`

Base URL for SEO meta tags (canonical, og\:url, hreflang).

- A concrete URL string (e.g. `'https://example.com'`) — used as-is (highest priority).
- `undefined` — falls back to `site.url` from `nuxt-site-config` when that module is
  present, otherwise the current request origin
  (`useRequestURL().origin` on server, `window.location.origin` on client).

### `metaTrustForwardedHost`

**Type** `boolean` · **Default** `true`

Trust the `X-Forwarded-Host` header when resolving the base URL for meta tags.
Enable when the app runs behind a reverse proxy (nginx, Cloudflare, AWS ALB, etc.)
that sets this header to the real client-facing hostname.

Read only when neither `metaBaseUrl` nor `site.url` is set. Set it to `false` when the app is reachable without a proxy that overwrites the header: a client could otherwise choose the host in your canonical URLs.

### `metaTrustForwardedProto`

**Type** `boolean` · **Default** `true`

Trust the `X-Forwarded-Proto` header when resolving the protocol for meta tags.
Enable when the app runs behind a TLS-terminating proxy so that
canonical URLs use `https://` even though the app itself listens on HTTP.

Same scope as `metaTrustForwardedHost`.

### `trustForwardedHost`

**Type** `boolean` · **Default** `false`

Choose the domain of a request (`locales[].baseUrl`) from `X-Forwarded-Host` instead of
`Host`. Enable it only behind a proxy that overwrites that header.

Separate from `metaTrustForwardedHost` and off by default: here the header would select another domain's locales, not only the origin of a tag. See [Layers and domains](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/guide/layers#multiple-domains).

### `hreflangBaseLanguage`

**Type** `boolean` · **Default** `false`

Also emit a bare-language `hreflang` derived from each locale's `iso`
(e.g. `es-ES` → also `es`). The first regional locale in `locales` claims
the bare tag for that language. Routing `code` is never used — only `iso || code`.

### `canonicalQueryWhitelist`

**Type** `string[]` · **Default** `['page', 'sort', 'filter', 'search', 'q', 'query', 'tag']`

List of query parameter names preserved in canonical and `og:url` meta tags.
Parameters not in this list are stripped from the canonical URL.

## Detection and redirects

The rules these options feed: [Locale detection](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/guide/locale-detection).

### `redirects`

**Type** `boolean` · **Default** `true`

Enable automatic locale redirects (server plugin and client route middleware).
When `true`, the prefix strategies redirect an unprefixed URL to its localized form. The locale
comes from the app state, the cookie or `Accept-Language` where `autoDetectPath` allows, otherwise
the default. Under `no_prefix` detection never changes the URL (see `noPrefixRedirect` for custom paths).

With `false` the client redirect middleware is not registered. The server plugin still returns 404 for invalid locale URLs and writes the cookie for a prefixed URL.

### `redirectStatusCode`

**Type** `number` · **Default** `302`

HTTP status of every redirect the server answers for the module: the preferred locale (cookie,
`Accept-Language`), a prefix in another case, and under `hashMode` + `prefix` the move into the
hash. `301` and `308` are cached by browsers: a visitor who later changes the preference is still
sent where the first answer said. One of 301, 302, 303, 307, 308; any other value warns at build
and 302 is used.

Keep `302` (or `307`) for redirects that depend on the visitor: a browser caches a `301` or `308` and goes straight to the first answer, even after the visitor switched the locale. The client redirects of a single-page navigation are router moves and have no status.

### `autoDetectLanguage`

**Type** `boolean` · **Default** `true`

Automatically detect the user's preferred language from the `Accept-Language` HTTP header.
Used in combination with `autoDetectPath` to decide when detection occurs.

### `autoDetectPath`

**Type** `string` · **Default** `'/'`

Where cookie / Accept-Language preference redirects may run (when `redirects` is enabled).

- `'/'` — only `/` (deep links in the default locale stay reachable; default)
- `'no_prefix'` — only paths without a locale prefix
- `'*'` — every path, including rewriting an explicit locale prefix
  (e.g. `/fr/about` → `/de/about` when the cookie prefers `de`)
- any other string — that path, trailing slashes ignored (e.g. `'/welcome'`)

Under `prefix`, an unprefixed URL outside the allowed paths still redirects to the default
locale's form (`/about` → `/en/about`). The default locale with a prefix under
`prefix_except_default` (`/en`) is a 404, not a redirect.

### `localeCookie`

**Type** `string | null` · **Default** `null`

Cookie name for persisting the user's locale preference across sessions.
Set to `null` to disable cookie-based persistence.
Automatically set to `'user-locale'` for the `no_prefix` strategy if not provided; an explicit
`null` in the `i18n` config block keeps it off there too.

Without a cookie, `Accept-Language` still drives redirects; the cookie remembers a choice across visits.

### `localeCookieOptions`

**Type** `LocaleCookieOptions` · **Default** `{}`

Attributes of the locale cookie (and of the hash cookie under `hashMode`), as the server and
the browser write it. Unset fields keep the defaults: `path: '/'`, `sameSite: 'lax'`, a year,
no `Domain`, no `Secure`. Build config only: no request decides them.

::field-group
  :::field{name="domain" type="string"}
  `Domain`: e.g. `.example.com` to share the cookie across subdomains. Unset: the host only.
  :::

  :::field{name="path" type="string"}
  **Default** `'/'` · `Path`.
  :::

  :::field{name="secure" type="boolean"}
  **Default** `false` · `Secure`: sent over HTTPS only. Required by browsers with `sameSite: 'none'`.
  :::

  :::field{name="sameSite" type="'lax' | 'strict' | 'none'"}
  **Default** `'lax'` · `SameSite`. `'none'` (e.g. an app inside an iframe) needs `secure: true`.
  :::

  :::field{name="maxAge" type="number"}
  **Default** `31536000 (one year)` · Lifetime in seconds (`Max-Age` and `Expires`).
  :::
::

```ts [nuxt.config.ts]
export default defineNuxtConfig({
  i18n: {
    localeCookie: 'user-locale',
    // one preference on example.com, de.example.com and app.example.com, also inside an iframe
    localeCookieOptions: { domain: '.example.com', secure: true, sameSite: 'none' },
  },
})
```

`sameSite: 'none'` without `secure: true` is rejected by browsers, and the build warns about it. The attributes come from the build config only: no request sets `Domain` or `Secure`. They apply to the `hash-locale` cookie under `hashMode` too.

### `noPrefixRedirect`

**Type** `boolean` · **Default** `false`

For `no_prefix` strategy: when the default locale has a custom path for a page
(`localeRoutes` / `globalLocaleRoutes`), redirect the page's original path to the custom
path of the visitor's locale, the default locale's otherwise (e.g. `/about` → `/about-us`).
A locale with no custom path of its own stays on the original path. Pages with dynamic
segments are not redirected.

### `prefixCaseRedirect`

**Type** `boolean` · **Default** `true`

Redirect a locale prefix in another case or encoding to the page in its own spelling
(`/DE/about` → `/de/about`, `/EN/about` → `/about` under `prefix_except_default`). The router
matches the prefix case-insensitively, so without the redirect such a URL would show the page
under a second address. When `false`, or when `redirects` is `false`, the URL is a 404. A URL
with no page behind it in its own spelling is a 404 either way.

## Registration and development

### `plugin`

**Type** `boolean` · **Default** `true`

Register the core i18n plugin that provides `$t()`, `$tc()`, `$getLocale()`,
`$switchLocale()`, and other runtime helpers.

### `define`

**Type** `boolean` · **Default** `true`

Provide `$defineI18nRoute()` at runtime. The build reads `$defineI18nRoute()` calls in pages
either way.

### `hooks`

**Type** `boolean` · **Default** `true`

Call the `i18n:register` app hook on load and on navigation so plugins can add translations.

See [Hooks](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/events).

### `components`

**Type** `boolean` · **Default** `true`

Register built-in i18n components (`<i18n-link>`, `<i18n-switcher>`, `<i18n-t>`, `<i18n-group>`).
Set to `false` to disable automatic component registration (e.g. if you don't use them
and want to reduce the module footprint).

### `types`

**Type** `boolean` · **Default** `true`

Generate TypeScript type declarations for `useI18n`, `$t`, and related helpers
based on the translation keys in your default locale files.

Separate from the [`@i18n-micro/types-generator`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/integrations/types-generator) package.

### `hmr`

**Type** `boolean` · **Default** `true`

Enable Hot Module Replacement for translation files in development.
When `true`, changes to JSON translation files trigger an automatic reload
without a full page refresh.

### `debug`

**Type** `boolean` · **Default** `false`

Enable verbose debug logging for locale detection, route generation, and translation loading.

### `vueDevtools`

**Type** `boolean` · **Default** `true`

Register Vue DevTools inspector and timeline in dev (browser extension).
Separate from the Nuxt DevTools custom tab.

### `experimental`

**Type** `Record<string, unknown>` · **Default** —

Bucket for experimental/unstable options.
Contents may change or be removed without notice between minor versions.

# Package APIs

The Nuxt module is built from small `@i18n-micro/*` packages, and most of them work on their own: `@i18n-micro/vue` in a Vue app, `@i18n-micro/core` anywhere. Use these pages to look up what a package exports, per entry point. Each page is generated from the snapshot that [`pnpm run api:surface`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/contributing/maintenance-commands#api-surface) checks against the TypeScript sources, so an export cannot change without CI noticing.

### Functions

#### `createAstroRouterAdapter`

Prefix-except-default routing over plain paths. Paths here never carry Astro's `base`: the
middleware strips it from what comes in and adds it to what goes out.

```ts
function createAstroRouterAdapter(
  locales: Locale[],
  defaultLocale: string,
  getCurrentUrl?: () => URL,
): I18nRoutingStrategy
```

**See** [`Locale`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages/types#locale) · [`I18nRoutingStrategy`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#i18nroutingstrategy)

#### `detectLocale`

Locale a visitor prefers: URL prefix → cookie → Accept-Language → default, the one precedence of
`resolveLocale`. An explicit prefix always wins; `autoDetect: false` leaves only the URL.

```ts
function detectLocale(
  pathname: string,
  cookies: { get: (name: string) => { value: string; } | undefined; },
  headers: Headers,
  defaultLocale: string,
  locales: string[],
  localeCookie?: string | null,
  routingStrategy?: I18nRoutingStrategy | null,
  autoDetect?: boolean,
): string
```

**See** [`I18nRoutingStrategy`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#i18nroutingstrategy)

Props for a client island: what `t()` can answer on this page (route, root and fallback keys),
or only `keys` of that, which is the way to keep the page small. Stored trees are shared, an
island must not write into them.
