#### `I18nMiddlewareOptions`

```ts
interface I18nMiddlewareOptions
```

::collapsible{name="9 properties"}
  :::field-group
    ::::field{required name="i18n" type="AstroI18n"}
    ::::

    ::::field{required name="defaultLocale" type="string"}
    ::::

    ::::field{required name="locales" type="string[]"}
    ::::

  :field{name="localeObjects" type="Locale[]"}

    ::::field{name="autoDetect" type="boolean"}
    `/` redirects to the locale the cookie / Accept-Language prefer (default `true`); pages keep the URL's locale.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="redirectToDefault" type="boolean"}
    `/` also redirects when nothing prefers another locale: to the home `routingStrategy` resolves
    for the default locale (default `false`). Without one `/` stays: it is the default locale's page.
    ::::

  :field{name="routingStrategy" type="I18nRoutingStrategy"}

    ::::field{name="localeCookie" type="string | null"}
    Cookie holding the visitor's locale (default `'i18n-locale'`); `null` disables it.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="base" type="string"}
    Astro's `base`, `config.base` of the virtual config.
    ::::
  :::
::

#### `I18nRoutingStrategy`

Routing strategy interface for i18n in Astro
Implement this interface to integrate with any routing logic
Matches Vue/Solid/React package interface for consistency
Adapted for Astro SSR context (push/replace are optional)

```ts
interface I18nRoutingStrategy
```

::collapsible{name="10 properties"}
  :::field-group
    ::::field{required name="getCurrentPath" type="() => string"}
    Returns current path (without locale prefix if needed, or full path)
    Used for determining active classes in links
    ::::

    ::::field
    ---
    name: resolvePath
    type: "(to: string | { path?: string; }, locale: string) => string | { path?:
      string; }"
    ---
    Generate path for specific locale
    ::::

    ::::field
    ---
    name: getRouteName
    type: "(path: string, locales: string[], routePattern?: string) => string"
    ---
    Get route name from path (e.g., /en/about -> about)
    Used in middleware to set route name. `routePattern` is the page's pattern (`/blog/[slug]`), with
    a `[locale]` param already replaced by its value: use it to give every URL of a page one name.
    ::::

    ::::field
    ---
    name: getLocaleFromPath
    type: "(path: string, defaultLocale: string, locales: string[]) => string"
    ---
    Get locale from path
    Checks if first segment is a locale code
    ::::

    ::::field
    ---
    name: switchLocalePath
    type: "(path: string, newLocale: string, locales: string[], defaultLocale?:
      string) => string"
    ---
    Switch locale in path
    Replaces or adds locale prefix to path
    ::::

    ::::field
    ---
    name: localizePath
    type: "(path: string, locale: string, locales: string[], defaultLocale?: string)
      => string"
    ---
    Localize path with locale prefix
    ::::

    ::::field
    ---
    name: removeLocaleFromPath
    type: "(path: string, locales: string[]) => string"
    ---
    Remove locale from path
    ::::

    ::::field{name="push" type="(target: { path: string; }) => void"}
    (Optional) Function to navigate to another route/locale
    Not used in SSR, but can be used in client-side islands
    ::::

    ::::field{name="replace" type="(target: { path: string; }) => void"}
    (Optional) Function to replace current route
    Not used in SSR, but can be used in client-side islands
    ::::

    ::::field
    ---
    name: getRoute
    type: "() => { fullPath: string; query: Record<string, unknown>; }"
    ---
    (Optional) Get current route object for SEO/Meta tags
    ::::
  :::
::

## `@i18n-micro/astro/client`

### Functions

#### `hasTranslation`

Checks if a translation exists in the state: a subtree counts, as on the server

```ts
function hasTranslation(state: I18nState, key: string, routeName?: string): boolean
```

**See** [`I18nState`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#i18nstate)

#### `translate`

Pure function to get a translation from state, answering as the server's `t()` does over the
same keys. `getI18nProps` already merged the root and fallback dictionaries into the state.
For Linked Messages (@\:path.to.key), use the server-side i18n instance.

```ts
function translate(
  state: I18nState,
  key: string,
  params?: Params,
  defaultValue?: string | null,
  routeName?: string,
): string | number | boolean | Translations | null
```

**See** [`I18nState`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#i18nstate) · [`Params`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages/types#params) · [`Translations`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages/types#translations)

### Functions

#### `provideI18n`

Initializes the i18n provider for a Vue island. Call in the island's root component, with a
getter (`() => props.i18n`) so an island kept by `transition:persist` follows its new props.
`shallowRef`: translations are never edited in place, and deep tracking costs 11× on every `t`.

```ts
function provideI18n(props: MaybeRefOrGetter<I18nClientProps>): Ref<I18nState>
```

**See** [`I18nClientProps`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#i18nclientprops) · [`I18nState`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#i18nstate)

# `@i18n-micro/cli`

Command-line tools for nuxt-i18n-micro: extract, sync, translate, lint and audit locale files.

```ts
import { … } from '@i18n-micro/cli'
```

## Functions

### `runCli`

Run the CLI. Failures set `process.exitCode`; nothing here throws.

```ts
function runCli(rawArgs: string[]): Promise<void>
```

## Constants

### `COMMAND_GROUPS`

```ts
const COMMAND_GROUPS: readonly ["Inspect", "Translation workflow", "Refactoring", "Exchange"]
```

**See** [`Translation`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages/types#translation)

### `commands`

```ts
const commands: Record<string, CommandSpec>
```

**See** [`CommandSpec`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#commandspec)

## Types

### `ArgSpec`

The command table: one source of truth for parsing, `--help` and the generated
[command reference](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/cli){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"}.

This file imports nothing, and handlers load on demand, so `--help` stays instant and the
docs generator can read the table without pulling in parsers or vendor drivers.

```ts
interface ArgSpec
```

::field-group
  :::field{required name="type" type="'string' | 'boolean' | 'positional'"}
  :::

  :::field{required name="description" type="string"}
  :::

:field{name="default" type="string | boolean"}

:field{name="required" type="boolean"}

:field{name="alias" type="string"}

  :::field{name="values" type="readonly string[]"}
  Accepted values: anything else is a usage error.
  :::

  :::field{name="numeric" type="'int' | 'number'"}
  Parsed to a number and checked to be positive.
  :::

  :::field{name="defaultHint" type="string"}
  Shown in the docs where a computed default has no literal value.
  :::
::

### `CommandGroup`

```ts
type CommandGroup = (typeof COMMAND_GROUPS)[number]
```

**See** [`COMMAND_GROUPS`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#command_groups)

### `CommandSpec`

```ts
interface CommandSpec
```

::field-group
  :::field{required name="description" type="string"}
  :::

  :::field{required name="group" type="CommandGroup"}
  :::

  :::field{required name="args" type="Record<string, ArgSpec>"}
  :::

:field{name="examples" type="string[]"}

  :::field
  ---
  required: true
  name: load
  type: "() => Promise<{ default: CommandHandler; }>"
  ---
  :::
::

# `@i18n-micro/core`

Core utilities for translations, formatting, and locale routing in Nuxt I18n Micro.

Entry points: `@i18n-micro/core`, `@i18n-micro/core/devtools`, `@i18n-micro/core/helpers`, `@i18n-micro/core/render`.

## `@i18n-micro/core`

### Functions

#### `collectTranslationPaths`

Adds every path of `obj` (objects and leaves, dotted) to `paths`. Arrays are leaves; a cycle is cut.

```ts
function collectTranslationPaths(
  obj: Tree,
  paths: Set<string>,
  prefix?: string,
  ancestors?: Set<object>,
): void
```

**See** [`Tree`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#tree)

#### `convertible`

What `t` hands back for a subtree or an array: that value, or, where `String()` throws on it, an equal copy that
converts. `v-html` and a template literal convert what they get, and a dictionary is no reason for a 500.

```ts
function convertible<T extends object>(value: T): T
```

#### `createReactiveI18nStore`

```ts
function createReactiveI18nStore(options: ReactiveI18nStoreOptions): ReactiveI18nStore
```

**See** [`ReactiveI18nStoreOptions`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#reactivei18nstoreoptions) · [`ReactiveI18nStore`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#reactivei18nstore)

#### `defaultPlural`

Default plural rule, see `pluralForm`. `locale` is the tag for `Intl.PluralRules`: an unknown
one gets the index rule, never the host's locale. Only the picked form is interpolated, with
`params` + `{count}`. Not a string: no plural.

```ts
function defaultPlural(
  key: string,
  count: number,
  params: Params,
  locale: string,
  getter: Getter,
): string | null
```

**See** [`Params`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages/types#params) · [`Getter`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages/test-utils#getter)

#### `escapeHtml`

```ts
function escapeHtml(text: string): string
```

#### `externalLinkHref`

The `href` of a link that leaves the app, `undefined` for a route: a bare domain gets `https://`,
anything else already says where it goes.

```ts
function externalLinkHref(to: unknown): string | undefined
```

#### `getByPath`

Own flat key first, then the dotted walk: objects by own key, arrays by index (`list.0`, never `list.length`).
`__proto__` is nothing, even as an own key: `JSON.parse` makes one, and a parsed tree is stored as it is.

```ts
function getByPath(obj: Tree | null | undefined, path: string): unknown
```

**See** [`Tree`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#tree)

#### `hasTranslationValue`

```ts
function hasTranslationValue(obj: Tree | null | undefined, key: string): boolean
```

**See** [`Tree`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#tree)

#### `interpolate`

Replaces `{name}` with `params.name` (`{0}` with an item of a list); a token without an own param stays as written.

```ts
function interpolate(template: string, params: TranslateParams): string
```

**See** [`TranslateParams`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages/types#translateparams)

#### `isActiveLink`

Whether a link to `link` is active on `current`: the same page, or a section above it. A locale
root (`/de`) is above every page of that locale, so it needs the same page.

```ts
function isActiveLink(
  current: string,
  link: string,
  localeCodes: readonly string[],
): boolean
```

#### `isNoPrefixStrategy`

```ts
function isNoPrefixStrategy(strategy: Strategies): strategy is 'no_prefix'
```

**See** [`Strategies`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages/types#strategies)

#### `isPlainClick`

A click the app may take over: primary button, no modifier, no `target`, no `download`. The rest are the browser's.

```ts
function isPlainClick(event: MouseEvent): boolean
```

#### `isPrefixAndDefaultStrategy`

```ts
function isPrefixAndDefaultStrategy(
  strategy: Strategies,
): strategy is 'prefix_and_default'
```

**See** [`Strategies`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages/types#strategies)

#### `isPrefixExceptDefaultStrategy`

```ts
function isPrefixExceptDefaultStrategy(
  strategy: Strategies,
): strategy is 'prefix_except_default'
```

**See** [`Strategies`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages/types#strategies)

#### `isPrefixStrategy`

```ts
function isPrefixStrategy(strategy: Strategies): strategy is 'prefix'
```

**See** [`Strategies`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages/types#strategies)

#### `isProduction`

`process.env.NODE_ENV` as bundlers inline it; an unbundled browser has no `process` and counts as development.

```ts
function isProduction(): boolean
```

#### `isSamePage`

Whether two URLs name one page: query, hash and a trailing slash do not count.

```ts
function isSamePage(a: string, b: string): boolean
```

#### `localeIsoMap`

`BaseI18nOptions.localeIso` of a locale list.

```ts
function localeIsoMap(
  locales: readonly { code: string; iso?: string; }[],
): Record<string, string>
```

#### `localizedPath`

`to` in `locale` for a prefix-except-default router: a leading locale segment is replaced, or
dropped for the default locale. Query and hash stay as they are.

```ts
function localizedPath(
  to: string | { path?: string; },
  locale: string,
  localeCodes: readonly string[],
  defaultLocale: string,
): string
```

#### `mergeTranslationChunk`

Deep merge of two trees into a new one; neither input is changed, and the result shares
nothing with `incoming`. Nested objects merge, everything else (arrays, scalars, null) replaces.
Of `existing`, only nodes on the patch's paths are copied.

```ts
function mergeTranslationChunk(
  existing: Tree,
  incoming: Tree,
  options?: MergeTranslationChunkOptions,
): Tree
```

**See** [`Tree`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#tree) · [`MergeTranslationChunkOptions`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#mergetranslationchunkoptions)

#### `mergeTranslationLayers`

Two live layers (`upper` wins) as one tree that answers every key `t()` answers through them.
A `null`/`undefined` in `upper` falls through. Where `upper` replaces an object or an array of
`lower`, its leaves come back as flat dotted keys (`getByPath` reads them first), but for the ones `upper` answers itself.

```ts
function mergeTranslationLayers(lower: Tree, upper: Tree): Tree
```

**See** [`Tree`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#tree)

#### `ownValue`

`obj[key]` if it is the object's own, in one property lookup on the hot path. Only a value
an object could have inherited (a function, or the value `Object.prototype` holds, e.g. after
prototype pollution) is double-checked with `hasOwnProperty`, as is `__proto__`.

```ts
function ownValue(obj: object, key: string): unknown
```

#### `pathEnd`

Where a URL's path ends: its first `?` or `#`, `-1` for neither.

```ts
function pathEnd(url: string): number
```

#### `pathSegments`

The segments of a path, as a browser reads the URL: `\` is a slash and a tab or a newline is dropped, so `/\host` cannot pass for a path.

```ts
function pathSegments(pathname: string): string[]
```

#### `pluralForm`

The picked form of a raw `a | b | c` value, trimmed and not interpolated.

```ts
function pluralForm(translation: string, count: number, locale: string): string
```

#### `resolveCachedTranslation`

`resolveTranslation` with the same per-tree leaf cache the helper uses, for adapters that keep
their own trees (Nuxt's active dictionary). The tree must never be mutated after it is read.

```ts
function resolveCachedTranslation(
  tree: Tree | null | undefined,
  key: string,
): unknown | null
```

**See** [`Tree`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#tree)

#### `resolveText`

The one way from component props to text: which value, which form, which params, html escaping.
`null` when `hideIfEmpty` hides it. Every `<i18n-t>` goes through it, directly or through `renderI18nT`.

```ts
function resolveText(i18n: TextHost, options: ResolveTextOptions): ResolvedText | null
```

**See** [`TextHost`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#texthost) · [`ResolveTextOptions`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#resolvetextoptions) · [`ResolvedText`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#resolvedtext)

#### `resolveTranslation`

`getByPath`, with "nothing there" (missing or `undefined`) as `null`.

```ts
function resolveTranslation(obj: Tree | null | undefined, key: string): unknown | null
```

**See** [`Tree`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#tree)

#### `routeQuery`

The `query` of a route from a search string, as vue-router parses it: `?tag=a&tag=b` gives
`{ tag: ['a', 'b'] }`, `?flag` gives `{ flag: null }`. An empty pair (`?a&&b`) counts for nothing.

```ts
function routeQuery(
  search: string | undefined,
): Record<string, string | null | (string | null)[]>
```

#### `setTranslationAtKey`

A copy of `tree` with `key` set to `value` (replaced, not merged). Only the nodes along the
path are copied; an array keeps its items when the next segment is an index (`list.1`, as
`getByPath` reads it), and any other non-object on the way becomes `{}`. An existing flat key is updated as is.

```ts
function setTranslationAtKey(tree: Tree, key: string, value: unknown): Tree
```

**See** [`Tree`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#tree)

#### `textOf`

`String` of any translation: a subtree may have a `toString` key, which is no method, an array may hold one. Nothing there: `undefined`.

```ts
function textOf(value: unknown): string | undefined
```

#### `tokenize`

`'Hi {a}, {b}!'` → `['Hi ', 'a', ', ', 'b', '!']`: text at even indexes, placeholder names at odd
ones. Works on the raw template, so a param value can never be taken for a placeholder. Cached by
template: the result is shared, do not mutate it.

```ts
function tokenize(template: string): readonly string[]
```

#### `translationCacheKey`

Storage key of one chunk: `locale:route` (`index` when the route is empty).

```ts
function translationCacheKey(locale: string, routeName?: string): string
```

#### `urlPath`

The URL up to its query and hash.

```ts
function urlPath(url: string): string
```

#### `withoutDots`

`/a/b/../c` → `/a/c`, or a `../` would climb out of a locale prefix added later. Read as a browser reads it, `\\` a slash and `%2e` a dot.

```ts
function withoutDots(path: string): string
```

#### `withPrefixStrategy`

```ts
function withPrefixStrategy(
  strategy: Strategies,
): strategy is 'prefix' | 'prefix_and_default'
```

**See** [`Strategies`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages/types#strategies)

### Classes

#### `BaseI18n`

Translation logic shared by every adapter (`t`, `ts`, `tc`, `tn`, `td`, `tdr`, `has`).
Adapters supply the current locale, fallback locale and route; lookups always read the
storage as it is now (no pinned trees; the helper's leaf cache is keyed by tree identity).

```ts
abstract class BaseI18n {
  constructor(options: BaseI18nOptions = {})
}
```

#### `TranslationHelper`

Reads and writes chunks of a `TranslationStorage`.

Every lookup starts from the Map as it is now, so writes made straight to
`storage.translations` (or by another helper on the same storage) are seen at once.

Stored trees are treated as immutable: a merge copies the nodes on the patch's paths and
stores a new root. Trees handed in by callers, returned by `t()` / `getCache`, shared between
route chunks or cloned storages stay as they were. Replace a chunk instead of editing one in place.

```ts
class TranslationHelper {
  constructor(storage?: TranslationStorage)
}
```

::collapsible{name="9 members"}
  :::field-group
  :field{name="readonly translations" type="Map<string, Translations>"}

  :field{name="getCache" type="(locale: string, routeName: string) => Translations | undefined"}

  :field{name="hasCache" type="(locale: string, routeName: string) => boolean"}

  :field{name="getTranslation" type="<T = unknown>(locale: string, routeName: string, key: string) => T | null"}

    ::::field
    ---
    name: lookup
    type: "(chunkKey: string, key: string) => unknown | null"
    ---
    Lookup by a ready chunk key (hot path: callers reuse the key string).
    ::::

    ::::field{name="hasTranslation" type="(locale: string, key: string) => boolean"}
    Whether any chunk of `locale` (any route) holds `key`.
    ::::

    ::::field
    ---
    name: setTranslations
    type: "(locale: string, data: Translations, routeName = 'index') => void"
    ---
    Replaces the chunk (stored as given, not copied: the caller hands it over).
    ::::

    ::::field
    ---
    name: mergeTranslation
    type: "(locale: string, routeName: string, incoming: Translations) => void"
    ---
    Deep-merges into the chunk; incoming wins.
    ::::

  :field{name="clearCache" type="() => void"}
  :::
::

**See** [`TranslationStorage`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#translationstorage)

#### `TranslationStorage`

Chunks keyed `locale:route`, each a nested tree. Adapters may share one between instances.

```ts
interface TranslationStorage
```

::field-group
  :::field{required name="translations" type="Map<string, Translations>"}
  :::
::

#### `Tree`

Translation trees: plain JSON objects whose leaves are strings, numbers, arrays, null.

Keys are read the way `t()` reads them: an own flat key (`'a.b': 'x'`) wins over the dotted
walk. `__proto__` is never read through or written, so no tree can reach a prototype.

```ts
type Tree = Record<string, unknown>
```

## `@i18n-micro/core/devtools`

### Functions

#### `buildInspectorState`

```ts
function buildInspectorState(
  snapshot: I18nDevtoolsStateSnapshot,
): Record<string, Array<{ key: string; value: unknown; editable?: boolean; }>>
```

**See** [`I18nDevtoolsStateSnapshot`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#i18ndevtoolsstatesnapshot)

#### `buildInspectorTree`

```ts
function buildInspectorTree(
  options: BuildInspectorTreeOptions,
): I18nDevtoolsInspectorNode[]
```

## `@i18n-micro/core/render`

### Functions

#### `createLocaleSwitcher`

One locale switcher for both sides. Call it from `setup`: it owns the open state and the document
listeners, and returns the render function.

```ts
function createLocaleSwitcher(
  vue: SwitcherVue,
  adapter: SwitcherAdapter,
  props: SwitcherProps,
  slots: RenderSlots,
): () => unknown
```

**See** [`SwitcherVue`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#switchervue) · [`SwitcherAdapter`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#switcheradapter) · [`SwitcherProps`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#switcherprops) · [`RenderSlots`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#renderslots)

#### `foldTemplate`

The template as children, one pass over its raw tokens: a slot, else a param, else the token as
written. A slot's fragment is keyed by name and occurrence, so a locale that reorders placeholders
moves the slot's DOM instead of rebuilding it.

```ts
function foldTemplate(
  renderSlot: (slot: RenderSlot, key: string) => unknown,
  template: string,
  params: Record<string, unknown>,
  slots: RenderSlots,
  textChild?: (text: string) => unknown,
): unknown
```

**See** [`RenderSlot`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#renderslot) · [`RenderSlots`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#renderslots)

#### `renderI18nT`

One `<i18n-t>`: `resolveText`, then markup, a default slot, or the folded template.

```ts
function renderI18nT(
  api: RenderApi,
  i18n: TextHost,
  props: I18nTRenderProps,
  slots: RenderSlots,
  attrs: Record<string, unknown>,
): unknown
```

**See** [`RenderApi`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#renderapi) · [`TextHost`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#texthost) · [`I18nTRenderProps`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#i18ntrenderprops) · [`RenderSlots`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#renderslots)

#### `RenderApi`

Vue's own functions, handed in: `@i18n-micro/vue` and the Nuxt module render with one code path,
and neither core nor the module depends on the other's copy of anything.

```ts
interface RenderApi
```

::field-group
  :::field
  ---
  required: true
  name: h
  type: "(type: any, props?: any, children?: any) => any"
  ---
  :::

  :::field{required name="Fragment" type="unknown"}
  :::

  :::field{name="markup" type="(html: string) => Record<string, unknown>"}
  The props putting trusted markup into an element. Vue's `innerHTML` when unset.
  :::

  :::field{name="dated" type="Record<string, unknown>"}
  The props telling hydration that clock-dependent text may differ. Vue's `data-allow-mismatch` when unset.
  :::
::

#### `SwitcherAdapter`

What a side supplies: its locales, its URLs and its navigation.

```ts
interface SwitcherAdapter
```

::field-group
  :::field{required name="locales" type="() => Locale[]"}
  Every locale, disabled ones too: a disabled current locale still labels the button.
  :::

  :::field{required name="locale" type="() => string"}
  :::

  :::field{name="localeName" type="() => string | null"}
  The label of a current locale missing from `locales`.
  :::

  :::field{required name="href" type="(code: string) => string"}
  :::

  :::field{required name="select" type="(code: string) => void"}
  The one navigation of a plain click; a modified click is left to the browser.
  :::

  :::field{name="browserNavigates" type="() => boolean"}
  The click is the browser's: `href` is a real page and nothing here navigates. `select` still runs.
  :::

  :::field{name="keepList" type="boolean"}
  Render the closed list too, so server HTML holds the links.
  :::

:field{name="onMissingLabel" type="(code: string) => void"}
::

# `@i18n-micro/node`

Node.js utilities for loading translations and locale data in Nuxt I18n Micro.

```ts
import { … } from '@i18n-micro/node'
```

## Functions

### `createI18n`

```ts
function createI18n(options: I18nOptions): I18n
```

**See** [`I18nOptions`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#i18noptions) · [`I18n`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#i18n)

### `loadRootTranslations`

Load only root-level translations from a directory

```ts
function loadRootTranslations(
  dir: string,
  disablePageLocales?: boolean,
): Promise<Record<string, Translations>>
```

::field-group
  :::field{required name="dir" type="string"}
  Directory path containing translation files
  :::

  :::field{name="disablePageLocales" type="boolean"}
  If true, ignores pages/ folder and treats all files as root translations
  :::
::

**See** [`Translations`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages/types#translations)

### `loadTranslations`

Load translations from a directory
Supports both flat structure (locales/{lang}.json) and nested structure (locales/pages/{page}/{lang}.json)

```ts
function loadTranslations(
  dir: string,
  disablePageLocales?: boolean,
): Promise<LoadedTranslations>
```

::field-group
  :::field{required name="dir" type="string"}
  Directory path containing translation files
  :::

  :::field{name="disablePageLocales" type="boolean"}
  If true, ignores pages/ folder and treats all files as global translations
  :::
::

**Returns** — Object with global and route-specific translations

**See** [`LoadedTranslations`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#loadedtranslations)

## Classes

### `I18n`

```ts
class I18n extends RuntimeI18n {
  constructor(options: I18nOptions)
}
```

::field-group
:field{name="translationDir" type="string"}

  :::field{name="protected store" type="ReactiveI18nStore"}
  Inside `run`, the shared instance answers with the request's locale and route. A fork always answers with its own.
  :::

  :::field{name="run" type="<T>(locale: string, fn: (i18n: this) => T) => T"}
  Runs `fn` with a fork for `locale` as the current request: until `fn` and everything it awaits
  finish, this instance reads and sets that fork's locale and route. `fn` also gets the fork.
  :::

:field{name="loadTranslations" type="(dir?: string) => Promise<void>"}

  :::field{name="reload" type="() => Promise<void>"}
  Re-reads the directory. The old dictionaries answer until the new ones are in, so no request sees an empty instance.
  :::
::

**See** [`I18nOptions`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#i18noptions)

# `@i18n-micro/path-strategy`

Shared strategy-based path and route name builder for Nuxt I18n Micro frontend routing.

Entry points: `@i18n-micro/path-strategy`, `@i18n-micro/path-strategy/types`.

## `@i18n-micro/path-strategy`

### Functions

#### `createPathStrategy`

```ts
function createPathStrategy(ctx: PathStrategyContext): PathStrategy
```

**See** [`PathStrategyContext`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#pathstrategycontext) · [`PathStrategy`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#pathstrategy)

### Classes

#### `DomainPathStrategy`

The strategy of a build with locale domains (`baseUrl`). On a known host (`ctx.domain`) the
locales of other domains are no URLs here, only link targets; on any other host the build config
routes and every `baseUrl` locale is a link target. A class of its own: an app without domains
does not ship it.

```ts
class DomainPathStrategy extends I18nPathStrategy {
  constructor(ctx: PathStrategyContext)
}
```

::field-group
  :::field{name="protected otherCodes" type="ReadonlySet<string>"}
  Locales whose URLs are no page here but name one (another domain's): `DomainPathStrategy`.
  :::

  :::field
  ---
  name: protected createIndex
  type: "(records: ReturnType<RouterAdapter['getRoutes']>) => Index"
  ---
  Records keep every locale's prefix (other hosts link there); the default of this host links to its unprefixed record.
  :::

  :::field
  ---
  name: protected external
  type: "(locale: string, route: Target) => string | null"
  ---
  A route in `locale` as an absolute URL on another domain: `DomainPathStrategy`.
  :::

:field{name="protected notFoundReason" type="(path: string) => string | null"}

  :::field
  ---
  name: switchLocaleRoute
  type: "(toLocale: string, route: ResolvedRouteLike, options?:
    SwitchLocaleOptions) => RouteLike | string"
  ---
  A link `localeRoute` made absolute reads as the page it shows, so it switches like any route.
  :::

  :::field
  ---
  name: localeRoute
  type: "(locale: string, routeOrPath: RouteLike | string) => RouteLike"
  ---
  An absolute link of a locale's own domain says where it goes (`<i18n-link :to="$localeRoute(x, 'de')">`).
  Any other absolute object stays a path: it can come from a request.
  :::

  :::field
  ---
  name: protected servedLocale
  type: "(route: ResolvedRouteLike, preferred: string) => string"
  ---
  A page restricted to some locales renders in one this host serves.
  :::

  :::field
  ---
  name: getClientRedirect
  type: "(currentPath: string, preferredLocale: string, options?:
    ClientRedirectOptions) => string | null"
  ---
  Where an unprefixed URL goes for the preferred locale (server plugin and client middleware),
  or null to stay. URLs with a locale prefix are never rewritten here.
  :::
::

**See** [`I18nPathStrategy`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#i18npathstrategy) · [`PathStrategyContext`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#pathstrategycontext)

### Types

#### `ClientRedirectOptions`

```ts
interface ClientRedirectOptions
```

::field-group
  :::field{name="switchPrefixed" type="boolean"}

  (the same page in that locale), not only unprefixed URLs.
  :::
::

#### `PathStrategy`

The public surface, structural: the Nuxt template imports the built `.mjs` by path, and a
class type with private members would not match the one TypeScript infers from that file.

```ts
type PathStrategy = {
  [K in keyof I18nPathStrategy]: I18nPathStrategy[K];
}
```

**See** [`I18nPathStrategy`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#i18npathstrategy)

#### `PathStrategyContext`

```ts
interface PathStrategyContext
```

::collapsible{name="11 properties"}
  :::field-group
    ::::field{required name="strategy" type="Strategies"}
    ::::

    ::::field{required name="defaultLocale" type="string"}
    ::::

    ::::field{required name="locales" type="Locale[]"}
    ::::

  :field{name="localizedRouteNamePrefix" type="string"}

    ::::field{required name="router" type="RouterAdapter"}
    ::::

    ::::field{name="hashMode" type="boolean"}
    Hash mode: the locale is not read from the URL.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="disablePageLocales" type="boolean"}
    All pages use the global translations only.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="customRegexMatcher" type="string"}
    Pattern of locale-like first segments (`customRegexMatcher`): one that is no known locale is a 404.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="prefixCaseRedirect" type="boolean"}
    A locale prefix in another case or encoding redirects to its own spelling (default); `false`: a 404.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="domain" type="string"}
    Host this strategy answers for (`DomainPathStrategy`); unset on a host no locale lives on.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="linkLocales" type="Locale[]"}
    With `domain`: every locale. Those missing from `locales` live on another domain.
    ::::
  :::
::

## `@i18n-micro/preact/router`

Also exports, as `@i18n-micro/preact` does: [`I18nRoutingStrategy`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages/react#i18nroutingstrategy).

### Functions

#### `createBrowserHistoryAdapter`

Adapter over the History API, for any router built on it (wouter, preact-router...). Links render
as `<a>`; `I18nLink` takes over plain clicks. A server has no address bar: pass the request's URL as
`ssrUrl`, so links and the switcher render for that page. In a browser the address bar wins.

```ts
function createBrowserHistoryAdapter(
  locales: Locale[],
  defaultLocale: string,
  ssrUrl?: string,
): I18nRoutingStrategy
```

**See** [`Locale`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages/types#locale) · [`I18nRoutingStrategy`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages/react#i18nroutingstrategy)

#### `useLocaleSwitch`

`setLocale` that loads first. A store write is synchronous for React, even inside
`startTransition`, so a reader that suspends on a missing dictionary would show its fallback:
this keeps the old UI until the messages are in. The last call wins; a failed `load` rejects
and leaves the locale as it was.

```ts
function useLocaleSwitch(
  load: (locale: string) => unknown,
): [ (locale: string) => Promise<void>, boolean ]
```

#### `useT`

One translation as a value: the component renders only when this string changes, not on every
locale or message write, nor when a provider gets a new adapter object.

```ts
function useT(
  key: TranslationKey,
  params?: Params,
  defaultValue?: string,
  routeName?: string,
): string
```

**See** [`TranslationKey`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages/types#translationkey) · [`Params`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages/types#params)

```ts
const I18nConfigContext: React.Context<I18nConfig | null>
```

**See** [`I18nConfig`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#i18nconfig)

#### `I18nContext`

The instance alone, stable while the app runs: `useT` and `<I18nT>` read only this, so a new
adapter object does not render them.

```ts
const I18nContext: React.Context<I18n | null>
```

**See** [`I18n`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages/node#i18n)

#### `I18nRoutingStrategy`

Routing strategy interface for i18n
Implement this interface to integrate with any router library
Matches Vue/Solid package interface for consistency

```ts
interface I18nRoutingStrategy
```

::field-group
  :::field{required name="getCurrentPath" type="() => string"}
  Returns the current path with its query and hash, so a locale switch keeps them.
  Links compare it by page: query and hash do not count.
  :::

  :::field
  ---
  name: linkComponent
  type: "string | HostComponent<{ href: string; children?: HostNode; style?:
    HostStyle; className?: string; [key: string]: unknown; }>"
  ---
  Component to use for rendering links (e.g., RouterLink)
  :::

  :::field{required name="push" type="(target: { path: string; }) => void"}
  Function to navigate to another route/locale
  :::

  :::field{required name="replace" type="(target: { path: string; }) => void"}
  Function to replace current route
  :::

  :::field
  ---
  name: resolvePath
  type: "(to: RouteTarget, locale: string) => RouteTarget"
  ---
  Generate path for specific locale
  :::

  :::field
  ---
  name: getRoute
  type: "() => { fullPath: string; query: Record<string, unknown>; }"
  ---
  (Optional) Get current route object for SEO/Meta tags
  :::
::

# `@i18n-micro/route-strategy`

Locale-aware route generator for Nuxt i18n micro

```ts
import { … } from '@i18n-micro/route-strategy'
```

## Functions

### `generateRoutes`

```ts
function generateRoutes(
  pages: NuxtPage[],
  options: GenerateOptions,
  localizedPaths?: LocalizedPaths,
): NuxtPage[]
```

**See** [`GenerateOptions`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#generateoptions)

### `isLocaleAllowedForUnlocalizedRoute`

Whether `localeCode` may serve this path given `$defineI18nRoute` locales / routeLocales.
Unrestricted paths (and restrictions naming no known locale) allow every locale.

```ts
function isLocaleAllowedForUnlocalizedRoute(
  routeLocales: Record<string, string[]>,
  locales: Locale[],
  routePath: string,
  localeCode: string,
): boolean
```

**See** [`Locale`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages/test-utils#locale)

### `localeMatcherSource`

The pattern of a `customRegexMatcher`: `/re/` and `re` alike, and a `RegExp` loses its flags, as in the route and in `path-strategy`.

```ts
function localeMatcherSource(matcher: string | RegExp): string
```

### `localesOutsideMatcher`

The codes `matcher` cannot route. The whole code must match, without flags: what the router and `path-strategy` will do.

```ts
function localesOutsideMatcher(
  codes: readonly string[],
  matcher: string | RegExp,
): string[]
```

### `nameOfPath`

The name Nuxt's scanner would give the path: `/a/:id()` -> `a-id`.

```ts
function nameOfPath(fullPath: string): string
```

### `normalizePath`

`a//b/` -> `a/b`; `''` and `.` -> `''`.

```ts
function normalizePath(routePath: string): string
```

### `normalizeRouteKey`

File-path and Nuxt forms of a route path to the vue-router form rules are keyed and written in:
`[...slug]` -> `:slug(.*)*`, `[[page]]` -> `:page?`, `[id]` -> `:id`, `:id()` -> `:id`
(non-empty matchers such as `:id(\d+)` stay).

```ts
function normalizeRouteKey(key: string): string
```

### `pageNames`

Route names of the pages, nested ones included.

```ts
function pageNames(pages: NuxtPage[]): string[]
```

### `routeKey`

Lookup key of a route path or name: normalized, without the leading slash (`/` for the root).

```ts
function routeKey(routePathOrName: string): string
```

### `Rules`

globalLocaleRoutes / $defineI18nRoute rules and routeLocales restrictions, keyed once by
routeKey so `about/team` and `/about/team` are looked up the same way everywhere. A page is
looked up by its full original path first (`about-team` / `/about-team` for a top-level page,
the form without the slash winning), then by its route name, which only keys written without a
leading slash can be.

```ts
class Rules {
  constructor(
    globalLocaleRoutes: GlobalLocaleRoutes = {},
    routeLocales: Record<string, string[]> = {},
    locales: Locale[] = [],
    routeDisableMeta: Record<string, NoMeta> = {},
  )
}
```

::field-group
:field{name="get" type="(fullPath: string, name: string | undefined) => Rule | undefined"}

  :::field
  ---
  name: allowedLocales
  type: "(fullPath: string, name: string | undefined) => string[] | undefined"
  ---
  Locales a page may be served in, or undefined when it is not restricted.
  :::

  :::field
  ---
  name: disableMeta
  type: "(fullPath: string, name: string | undefined) => NoMeta | undefined"
  ---
  `$defineI18nRoute({ disableMeta })`: SEO tags off for the page (every locale, or the listed ones).
  :::

  :::field
  ---
  name: customKeysUnder
  type: "(base: string, locale: string) => string[]"
  ---
  Keys of the pages at or under `base` (a route key) with a custom path in `locale`: where a wildcard rule's pages live.
  :::

  :::field
  ---
  name: customPath
  type: "(fullPath: string, locale: string) => string | undefined"
  ---
  Custom path of a top-level path for a locale (nitro: prerender and routeRules).
  :::
::

**See** [`GlobalLocaleRoutes`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages/types#globallocaleroutes) · [`Locale`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages/test-utils#locale)

    Under prefix_except_default / prefix_and_default: locales that are the default of a domain in
    the same build. They get unprefixed records too, and prefix_except_default keeps every prefix
    (the default of one domain is a link target of the others, and the build default of an unknown host).
    ::::

    ::::

### `I18n`

```ts
class I18n extends BaseI18n {
  constructor(options: I18nOptions)
}
```

::collapsible{name="22 members"}
  :::field-group
  :field{name="protected readonly ownStore" type="ReactiveI18nStore"}

    ::::field{name="storage" type="TranslationStorage"}
    The chunks of this instance. Handing them out detaches a fork: what the caller does with them stays here.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="protected store" type="ReactiveI18nStore"}
    The locale, fallback and route state in force. An adapter with per-request state answers its own.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="fork" type="(locale: string = this.getLocale()) => this"}
    A cheap instance for one request or task: own locale, fallback and route, the same dictionaries,
    formatters and rules. It sees writes to the parent until its first own write; its writes stay in it.
    Forking a fork counts as that fork's first write.
    ::::

  :field{name="subscribe" type="(listener: () => void) => () => void"}

  :field{name="getSnapshot" type="() => string"}

  :field{name="locale" type="string"}

  :field{name="fallbackLocale" type="string"}

  :field{name="currentRoute" type="string"}

  :field{name="setRoute" type="(routeName: string) => void"}

  :field{name="getLocale" type="() => string"}

  :field{name="getFallbackLocale" type="() => string"}

  :field{name="getRoute" type="() => string"}

    ::::field
    ---
    name: loadMessages
    type: "(messages?: Record<string, Translations>, routeMessages?: Record<string,
      Record<string, Translations>>) => void"
    ---
    Load root and optional route-scoped translation maps into the instance. A route chunk holds
    the route's own keys; root keys resolve from the root chunk (also ones added later).
    ::::

    ::::field
    ---
    name: addLocaleIso
    type: "(localeIso: Record<string, string>, notify = true) => void"
    ---
    Text on screen follows a new plural tag. A render passes `notify: false`: it must not wake other components.
    ::::

  :field{name="loadFromUrl" type="(url: string, options: LoadFromUrlOptions = {}) => Promise<void>"}

    ::::field
    ---
    name: loadFromUrls
    type: "(entries: LoadFromUrlEntry[]) => Promise<void>"
    ---
    All or nothing: a failed fetch leaves the dictionaries as they were. Merged in entry order.
    ::::

  :field{name="addTranslations" type="(locale: string, translations: Translations, merge = true) => void"}

  :field{name="addRouteTranslations" type="(locale: string, routeName: string, translations: Translations, merge = true) => void"}

  :field{name="hasTranslation" type="(key: TranslationKey) => boolean"}

  :field{name="clear" type="() => void"}

    ::::field
    ---
    name: protected onTranslationsChanged
    type: "(locale?: string) => void"
    ---
    Called after every write (load, merge, set, clear): the one place adapters bump their reactivity.
    `locale` is set when one locale's chunk was written, unset when anything may have changed.
    ::::
  :::
::

**See** [`BaseI18n`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages/core#basei18n) · [`I18nOptions`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#i18noptions)

## Types

### `I18nOptions`

```ts
interface I18nOptions
```

::collapsible{name="13 properties"}
  :::field-group
    ::::field{required name="locale" type="string"}
    ::::

  :field{name="fallbackLocale" type="string"}

    ::::field{name="messages" type="Record<string, Translations>"}
    Root translations keyed by locale code.
    ::::

    ::::field
    ---
    name: routeMessages
    type: Record<string, Record<string, Translations>>
    ---
    Route-specific translations: routeName → locale → messages.
    ::::

  :field{name="plural" type="PluralFunc"}

  :field{name="missingWarn" type="boolean"}

  :field{name="missingHandler" type="(locale: string, key: string, routeName: string) => void"}

    ::::field{name="numberFormats" type="NumberFormatsConfig"}
    Named number formats per locale (`tn(n, 'currency')`).
    ::::

    ::::field{name="datetimeFormats" type="DateTimeFormatsConfig"}
    Named datetime formats per locale (`td(d, 'short')`).
    ::::

    ::::field{name="timeZone" type="string"}
    IANA zone for dates (`Europe/Berlin`): set it so server and browser render one date.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="now" type="() => number"}
    The clock of relative dates: hand hydration the server's time so both render one text.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="localeIso" type="Record<string, string>"}
    BCP 47 tag per locale code (`iso`), for a code that is no language tag: `ua` → `uk-UA`. `localeIsoMap(locales)` builds it.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="parent" type="I18n"}
    Set by `fork()`: the instance whose dictionaries, formatters and rules this one shares.
    ::::
  :::
::

### Classes

#### `SolidI18n`

The runtime instance with signals over its store. A translation read tracks the revision, which
every change bumps. Reading the locale tracks the locale alone, so `createEffect(() => load(locale()))`
does not wake itself. `getLocale()` and `getRoute()` stay plain, as a write reads them too: track
with `locale` and `currentRoute`.

```ts
class SolidI18n extends I18n {
  constructor(options: SolidI18nOptions)
}
```

::field-group
:field{name="readonly localeAccessor" type="Accessor<string>"}

:field{name="readonly routeAccessor" type="Accessor<string>"}

  :::field{name="protected touch" type="() => void"}
  Called before every read; adapters use it for reactivity tracking.
  :::

:field{name="locale" type="string"}

:field{name="fallbackLocale" type="string"}

:field{name="currentRoute" type="string"}
::

**See** [`I18n`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages/node#i18n) · [`SolidI18nOptions`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#solidi18noptions)

#### `I18nRoutingStrategy`

Routing strategy interface for i18n
Implement this interface to integrate with any router library
Matches Vue package interface for consistency

```ts
interface I18nRoutingStrategy
```

::field-group
  :::field{required name="getCurrentPath" type="() => string"}
  Returns the current path with its query and hash, so a locale switch keeps them. Links compare
  it by page. Read a signal or a reactive location here and links and the switcher follow it.
  :::

  :::field
  ---
  name: linkComponent
  type: "string | Component<{ href: string; children?: JSX.Element; style?:
    JSX.CSSProperties | string; class?: string; [key: string]: unknown; }>"
  ---
  Component to use for rendering links (e.g., RouterLink)
  :::

  :::field{required name="push" type="(target: { path: string; }) => void"}
  Function to navigate to another route/locale
  :::

  :::field{required name="replace" type="(target: { path: string; }) => void"}
  Function to replace current route
  :::

  :::field
  ---
  name: resolvePath
  type: "(to: RouteTarget, locale: string) => RouteTarget"
  ---
  Generate path for specific locale
  :::

  :::field
  ---
  name: getRoute
  type: "() => { fullPath: string; query: Record<string, unknown>; }"
  ---
  (Optional) Get current route object for SEO/Meta tags
  :::
::

## `@i18n-micro/solid/router`

Also exports, as `@i18n-micro/solid` does: [`I18nRoutingStrategy`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#i18nroutingstrategy).

### Functions

#### `createSolidRouterAdapter`

Factory for Solid Router adapter

`location` is the router's reactive object, so reading the path inside a memo or JSX follows
navigation without a signal of its own.

```ts
function createSolidRouterAdapter(
  locales: Locale[],
  defaultLocale: string,
  navigate: NavigateFunction,
  location: Location,
): I18nRoutingStrategy
```

::field-group
  :::field{required name="locales" type="Locale[]"}
  Array of locale configurations
  :::

  :::field{required name="defaultLocale" type="string"}
  Default locale code
  :::

  :::field{required name="navigate" type="NavigateFunction"}
  Navigation function from
  :::

  :::field{required name="location" type="Location"}
  Location object from
  :::
::

**Returns** — I18nRoutingStrategy

```ts
const RouterRoot: Component = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const location = useLocation()
  const routingStrategy = createSolidRouterAdapter(locales, defaultLocale, navigate, location)
  // ...
}
```

**See** [`Locale`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages/types#locale) · [`I18nRoutingStrategy`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#i18nroutingstrategy)

Includes `$…` methods, bare aliases (`t` / `$t`), `helper`, and test setters.

for a private translation cache.

### `resetI18n`

Reset the shared mock state and clear the translation cache.
Call from `beforeEach` so tests do not leak dictionaries/locales.
For isolated harnesses, use the `reset` returned by `setupNuxtI18nMock` / `createIsolatedFakeI18n`.

```ts
function resetI18n(options?: ResetI18nOptions): void
```

**See** [`ResetI18nOptions`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#reseti18noptions)

### `setupNuxtI18nMock`

One-call harness for Nuxt unit tests: isolated fake, optional `beforeEach` reset,
and a `useI18n` factory for `mockNuxtImport`.

```ts
function setupNuxtI18nMock(options?: SetupNuxtI18nMockOptions): NuxtI18nMockHarness
```

```ts
import { setupNuxtI18nMock } from '@i18n-micro/test-utils'
import { mockNuxtImport } from '@nuxt/test-utils/runtime'
import { beforeEach, vi } from 'vitest'

const { i18n, useI18n, setTranslationsFromJson } = setupNuxtI18nMock({
  spy: vi.fn,
  beforeEach,
  translations: { welcome: 'Welcome' },
})

mockNuxtImport('useI18n', () => useI18n)
export { i18n, setTranslationsFromJson }
```

**See** [`SetupNuxtI18nMockOptions`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#setupnuxti18nmockoptions) · [`NuxtI18nMockHarness`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#nuxti18nmockharness)

## Classes

### `I18nTestContext`

Stateful i18n mock. Translation, plural and format calls are `BaseI18n`'s own: a test answers
what the app answers. What is added here is the test state: setters, seeds and path stubs.
The package's default singleton backs the module-level helpers (`t`, `resetI18n`, …).

```ts
class I18nTestContext extends BaseI18n {
  constructor(options: CreateI18nTestContextOptions = {})
}
```

::collapsible{name="31 members"}
  :::field-group
  :field{name="strategy" type="TestStrategy"}

  :field{name="pagePath" type="string"}

  :field{name="getLocale" type="() => string"}

  :field{name="getFallbackLocale" type="() => string"}

  :field{name="getRoute" type="() => string"}

    ::::field
    ---
    name: reset
    type: "(options: ResetI18nOptions & { reseed?: boolean; } = {}) => void"
    ---
    Clear cache and restore locale/route defaults.
    Pass `reseed: true` (or explicit `translations` / `messages`) to reload factory seeds.
    ::::

  :field{name="_t" type="(route: unknown) => (key: TranslationKey, params?: Params, defaultValue?: string | null) => Translation"}

### `i18nStrategy`

Minimal strategy stub so `useI18n().$i18nStrategy` does not throw.

```ts
const i18nStrategy: {
  getStrategy: () => TestStrategy;
  getDefaultLocale: () => string;
  getLocales: () => Locale[];
  getLocalizedRouteNamePrefix: () => string;
  getRouteBaseName: () => null;
  pageLocales: () => null;
  isMetaDisabled: () => boolean;
  setRouter: () => void;
  shouldReturn404: () => null;
  getClientRedirect: () => null;
  resolveLocaleFromPath(path: string): string | null;
  getLocaleFromPath(path: string): string | null;
  getCurrentLocale: () => string;
  getPluginRouteName: () => string;
  getCurrentLocaleName: () => string | null;
  localeRoute(targetLocale: string, routeOrPath: unknown): {
    path: string;
    fullPath: string;
  };
  switchLocaleRoute(toLocale: string, route?: unknown): {
    path: string;
    fullPath: string;
  };
}
```

```ts
  _t: (route: unknown) => (key: TranslationKey, params?: Params, defaultValue?: string | null) => Translation;
  _ts: (route: unknown) => (key: TranslationKey, params?: Params, defaultValue?: string | null) => string;
  mergeTranslations: (newTranslations: Translations) => void;
  resolveTranslations: (routeContext?: unknown) => Translations;
  setTranslation: (key: TranslationKey, value: unknown) => void;
  switchLocaleRoute: (loc: string) => {
    path: string;
    name: string;
  };
  switchLocalePath: (loc: string) => string;
  switchLocale: (val: string) => void;
  switchRoute: (route: unknown, toLocale?: string) => void;
  localeRoute: (to: unknown, loc?: string) => {
    name?: string | symbol | undefined;
    path: string;
  };
  localePath: (to: unknown, loc?: string) => string;
  setI18nRouteParams: (value: unknown) => unknown;
}
```

**See** [`TranslationKey`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages/types#translationkey) · [`TranslateParams`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages/types#translateparams) · [`CleanTranslation`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages/types#cleantranslation) · [`Params`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages/types#params) · [`ResetI18nOptions`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#reseti18noptions) · [`CreateFakeI18nOptions`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#createfakei18noptions) · [`TestStrategy`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#teststrategy) · [`Locale`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#locale) · [`Translation`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages/types#translation) · [`Translations`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages/types#translations) · [`MissingHandler`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages/types#missinghandler) · [`TranslationHelper`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages/core#translationhelper) · [`IsolatedFakeI18n`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#isolatedfakei18n) · [`SetupNuxtI18nMockOptions`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#setupnuxti18nmockoptions) · [`NuxtI18nMockHarness`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#nuxti18nmockharness) · [`CreateI18nTestContextOptions`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#createi18ntestcontextoptions) · [`I18nTestContext`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#i18ntestcontext)

### `Locale`

Locale configuration object.

Supports arbitrary custom properties via the index signature `[key: string]: unknown`.
To get full TypeScript support for your custom properties, use module augmentation:

```typescript
// app/i18n.d.ts (or any .d.ts file included in your tsconfig)
declare module '@i18n-micro/types' {
  interface Locale {
    flag?: string
    currency?: string
  }
}
```

Then access them with full typing:

```typescript
const locales = $getLocales()
locales[0].flag     // string | undefined  (typed!)
locales[0].currency // string | undefined  (typed!)
```

```ts
interface Locale
```

::collapsible{name="11 properties"}
  :::field-group
    ::::field{required name="code" type="LocaleCode"}
    BCP-47 locale code (e.g. `'en'`, `'de-DE'`, `'zh-Hans'`). Used in URLs and as file/key identifier.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="disabled" type="boolean"}
    When `true`, this locale is excluded from route generation and language switching.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="iso" type="string"}
    ISO 639-1 / BCP-47 tag for `<html lang>` and `hreflang` SEO attributes (e.g. `'en-US'`).
    ::::

    ::::field{name="og" type="string"}
    Open Graph locale for `og:locale` / `og:locale:alternate` meta `content` (e.g. `ar_AE`).
    When omitted, `iso` is converted to OG format when possible (`en-US` → `en_US`).
    If conversion is not possible, `og:locale` tags are not emitted (dev warning when `missingWarn` is enabled).
    ::::

    ::::field{name="seo" type="boolean"}
    **Default** `true when omitted.` · When `false`, this locale is omitted from cross-locale SEO tags (`hreflang`,
    `og:locale:alternate`). If the configured default locale has `seo: false`, the
    `x-default` hreflang link is not emitted. Routing and translations are unchanged.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="dir" type="'ltr' | 'rtl' | 'auto'"}
    Text direction. Reflected in `<html dir>` when the locale is active.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="displayName" type="string"}
    Human-readable name shown in language switchers (e.g. `'English'`, `'Deutsch'`).
    ::::

    ::::field{name="baseUrl" type="string"}
    Origin of this locale's own domain (e.g. `'https://de.example.com'`), plus `app.baseURL` when
    the app has one. One build then serves every domain: a request for that host gets this locale,
    the other locales of the host and the locales with no `baseUrl`. Links into a locale of another
    domain (`$localePath`, `$switchLocalePath`, the switcher, `hreflang`) become absolute URLs on
    its origin, and switching to it navigates there. Any other host gets the build config.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="baseDefault" type="boolean"}
    With `baseUrl`: this locale is the default of its host, unprefixed there, and links to it from
    other domains drop `/<code>`, because the domain already names the locale
    (`https://de.example.com/about`, not `…/de/about`). `prefix` keeps the prefix in both.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="fallbackLocale" type="string"}
    Locale code to fall back to when a translation key is missing in this locale.
    Overrides the global `fallbackLocale` for this specific locale.
    ::::

  :field{name="[key: string]" type="unknown"}
  :::
::

### `LocaleCode`

### `LocaleCookieOptions`

Attributes of the locale cookie (`localeCookieOptions`).

```ts
interface LocaleCookieOptions
```

::field-group
  :::field{name="domain" type="string"}
  `Domain`: e.g. `.example.com` to share the cookie across subdomains. Unset: the host only.
  :::

  :::field{name="path" type="string"}
  **Default** `'/'` · `Path`.
  :::

  :::field{name="secure" type="boolean"}
  **Default** `false` · `Secure`: sent over HTTPS only. Required by browsers with `sameSite: 'none'`.
  :::

  :::field{name="sameSite" type="'lax' | 'strict' | 'none'"}
  **Default** `'lax'` · `SameSite`. `'none'` (e.g. an app inside an iframe) needs `secure: true`.
  :::

  :::field{name="maxAge" type="number"}
  **Default** `31536000 (one year)` · Lifetime in seconds (`Max-Age` and `Expires`).
  :::
