### `ModuleOptions`

```ts
interface ModuleOptions
```

::collapsible{name="57 properties"}
  :::field-group
    ::::field{name="locales" type="Locale[]"}
    **Default** `[]` · List of supported locales.
    Each entry defines a locale code plus optional metadata (ISO, direction, display name, etc.).
    ::::

    ::::field{name="meta" type="boolean"}
    **Default** `true` · Generate SEO meta tags (`hreflang`, `canonical`, `og:url`, `og:locale`) automatically.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="strategy" type="Strategies"}
    **Default** `'prefix_except_default'` · URL routing strategy for locale prefixes.

    - `'no_prefix'` — no locale in URL; locale stored in cookie.
    - `'prefix_except_default'` — prefix all locales except the default.
    - `'prefix'` — always prefix, including the default locale.
    - `'prefix_and_default'` — like `prefix`, but the default locale is also accessible without prefix.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="metaBaseUrl" type="string"}
    **Default** `undefined` · Base URL for SEO meta tags (canonical, og\:url, hreflang).

    - A concrete URL string (e.g. `'https://example.com'`) — used as-is (highest priority).
    - `undefined` — falls back to `site.url` from `nuxt-site-config` when that module is
      present, otherwise the current request origin
      (`useRequestURL().origin` on server, `window.location.origin` on client).
    ::::

    ::::field{name="metaTrustForwardedHost" type="boolean"}
    **Default** `true` · Trust the `X-Forwarded-Host` header when resolving the base URL for meta tags.
    Enable when the app runs behind a reverse proxy (nginx, Cloudflare, AWS ALB, etc.)
    that sets this header to the real client-facing hostname.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="metaTrustForwardedProto" type="boolean"}
    **Default** `true` · Trust the `X-Forwarded-Proto` header when resolving the protocol for meta tags.
    Enable when the app runs behind a TLS-terminating proxy so that
    canonical URLs use `https://` even though the app itself listens on HTTP.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="trustForwardedHost" type="boolean"}
    **Default** `false` · Choose the domain of a request (`locales[].baseUrl`) from `X-Forwarded-Host` instead of
    `Host`. Enable it only behind a proxy that overwrites that header.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="hreflangBaseLanguage" type="boolean"}
    **Default** `false` · Also emit a bare-language `hreflang` derived from each locale's `iso`
    (e.g. `es-ES` → also `es`). The first regional locale in `locales` claims
    the bare tag for that language. Routing `code` is never used — only `iso || code`.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="define" type="boolean"}
    **Default** `true` · Provide `$defineI18nRoute()` at runtime. The build reads `$defineI18nRoute()` calls in pages
    either way.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="redirects" type="boolean"}
    **Default** `true` · Enable automatic locale redirects (server plugin and client route middleware).
    When `true`, the prefix strategies redirect an unprefixed URL to its localized form. The locale
    comes from the app state, the cookie or `Accept-Language` where `autoDetectPath` allows, otherwise
    the default. Under `no_prefix` detection never changes the URL (see `noPrefixRedirect` for custom paths).
    ::::

    ::::field{name="prefixCaseRedirect" type="boolean"}
    **Default** `true` · Redirect a locale prefix in another case or encoding to the page in its own spelling
    (`/DE/about` → `/de/about`, `/EN/about` → `/about` under `prefix_except_default`). The router
    matches the prefix case-insensitively, so without the redirect such a URL would show the page
    under a second address. When `false`, or when `redirects` is `false`, the URL is a 404. A URL
    with no page behind it in its own spelling is a 404 either way.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="plugin" type="boolean"}
    **Default** `true` · Register the core i18n plugin that provides `$t()`, `$tc()`, `$getLocale()`,
    `$switchLocale()`, and other runtime helpers.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="hooks" type="boolean"}
    **Default** `true` · Call the `i18n:register` app hook on load and on navigation so plugins can add translations.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="components" type="boolean"}
    **Default** `true` · Register built-in i18n components (`<i18n-link>`, `<i18n-switcher>`, `<i18n-t>`, `<i18n-group>`).
    Set to `false` to disable automatic component registration (e.g. if you don't use them
    and want to reduce the module footprint).
    ::::

    ::::field{name="serverTranslationPreload" type="boolean"}
    **Default** `false` · Preload index-page translations in Nitro global middleware (server-only, private config).
    ::::

    ::::field{name="defaultLocale" type="string"}
    **Default** `'en'` · The locale to use when no locale can be determined from URL or user preferences.
    It is not a translation fallback: set `fallbackLocale` for that.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="apiBaseUrl" type="string"}
    **Default** `'_locales'` · Base URL path segment for the translations API route (used in SSR/SSG data fetching).
    Can also be set via `NUXT_I18N_APP_BASE_URL` environment variable.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="apiBaseClientHost" type="string"}
    **Default** `undefined` · Override the host used for client-side translation fetch requests.
    Useful when the client reaches the server via a different hostname than the one Nuxt sees.
    Can also be set via `NUXT_I18N_APP_BASE_CLIENT_HOST` environment variable.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="apiBaseServerHost" type="string"}
    **Default** `undefined` · Override the host used for server-side translation fetch requests.
    Useful in container/microservice setups where the server reaches itself via an internal hostname.
    Can also be set via `NUXT_I18N_APP_BASE_SERVER_HOST` environment variable.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="translationDir" type="string"}
    **Default** `'locales'` · Path to the directory containing translation JSON files, relative to the project root.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="additionalTranslationDirs" type="string[]"}
    **Default** `[]` · Extra directories whose top-level `{locale}.json` files are deep-merged into the global
    dictionary before `translationDir`. A relative path is read in the project root and in each
    Nuxt layer root; an absolute path (a Nuxt module's own folder) is read once. Merge order: each entry in array order (across layers), then `translationDir` (wins on conflicts).
    Only root `{locale}.json` files are read — `pages/` under these dirs is ignored.
    Entries other modules add to `nuxt.options.i18n.additionalTranslationDirs` count, whatever their order. Example: `translationDir: 'frontend'`, `additionalTranslationDirs: ['common']` → `common/en.json` then `frontend/en.json`.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="translationPayloads" type="TranslationPayloadOptions"}
    Controls how translation payloads are emitted (Node server: `public/<apiBaseUrl>`; Edge / function / inline: Nitro `serverAssets`).

    - **Node server** (`node-server`, `node-cluster`, disk `serveStatic`): `serverAssets` means local SSR via `readFile` under `public/` (no Rollup `raw:`).
    - **Edge, function presets, and `serveStatic: "inline"`** (`vercel`, `netlify`, `aws-lambda`, winterjs, …): `serverAssets` registers Nitro `serverAssets` (`assets:i18n`),
      because `public/` is not available to SSR on disk. Does not force a public copy — set `publicAssets: true` for CDN/static. Keep the defaults for the usual all-in-one setup. For large Edge catalogs prefer `mode: 'source'`.
      For CDN-backed deployments, disable local outputs and set `apiBaseClientHost` / `apiBaseServerHost`.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="autoDetectLanguage" type="boolean"}
    **Default** `true` · Automatically detect the user's preferred language from the `Accept-Language` HTTP header.
    Used in combination with `autoDetectPath` to decide when detection occurs.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="autoDetectPath" type="string"}
    **Default** `'/'` · Where cookie / Accept-Language preference redirects may run (when `redirects` is enabled).

    - `'/'` — only `/` (deep links in the default locale stay reachable; default)
    - `'no_prefix'` — only paths without a locale prefix
    - `'*'` — every path, including rewriting an explicit locale prefix
      (e.g. `/fr/about` → `/de/about` when the cookie prefers `de`)
    - any other string — that path, trailing slashes ignored (e.g. `'/welcome'`)

    Under `prefix`, an unprefixed URL outside the allowed paths still redirects to the default
    locale's form (`/about` → `/en/about`). The default locale with a prefix under
    `prefix_except_default` (`/en`) is a 404, not a redirect.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="disableWatcher" type="boolean"}
    **Default** `false` · Disable the file watcher that auto-creates missing translation files in development mode.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="types" type="boolean"}
    **Default** `true` · Generate TypeScript type declarations for `useI18n`, `$t`, and related helpers
    based on the translation keys in your default locale files.
    ::::

    ::::field
    ---
    name: routesLocaleLinks
    type: "{ [key: string]: string; }"
    ---
    **Default** `{}` · Map route names to other route names to share the same translation files.
    For example, `{ 'about-us': 'about' }` means the `about-us` page will use
    translations from the `about` page instead of its own.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="plural" type="PluralFunc"}
    **Default** ``built-in pluralization (a non-negative integer count picks the form at that index, clamped to the last; negative, fractional and `NaN` counts take the last; `=0 ` opens a template of `Intl.PluralRules` categories)`` · Custom pluralization function.
    Receives `(key, count, params, locale, getter)` and should return the selected
    plural form as a string, or `null`/`undefined` to fall back to the built-in
    `defaultPlural` logic (so you can override only some locales). For the Nuxt module the function is serialized with `.toString()` into
    `.nuxt/i18n.plural.mjs` — it must be self-contained (no imports / outer scope).
    A file path string is **not** supported.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="disablePageLocales" type="boolean"}
    **Default** `false` · Disable per-page translation files.
    When `true`, only global translations (`{locale}.json`) are loaded;
    page-specific files (`pages/{page}/{locale}.json`) are not generated or loaded.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="fallbackLocale" type="string"}
    **Default** `undefined (no fallback; returns the raw key)` · Global fallback locale code.
    Keys missing in a locale are taken from this locale (merged into each payload when it is
    built or loaded); without it a missing key renders as the key itself.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="redirectStatusCode" type="number"}
    **Default** `302` · HTTP status of every redirect the server answers for the module: the preferred locale (cookie,
    `Accept-Language`), a prefix in another case, and under `hashMode` + `prefix` the move into the
    hash. `301` and `308` are cached by browsers: a visitor who later changes the preference is still
    sent where the first answer said. One of 301, 302, 303, 307, 308; any other value warns at build
    and 302 is used.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="linkedMessages" type="boolean"}
    **Default** `false` · Resolve linked messages (`@:key`, `@.upper:key`, `@.lower:key`, `@.capitalize:key`, `@:{'key'}`)
    in each built dictionary, so the runtime never parses them. A link to a missing key, or a
    cycle, leaves the message as written and warns at build. Translations added at runtime
    (`$mergeTranslations`, `i18n:register`, inline `$defineI18nRoute`) are not resolved.
    Off by default: `@:` may already be plain text in your messages.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="localeCookie" type="string | null"}
    **Default** `null` · Cookie name for persisting the user's locale preference across sessions.
    Set to `null` to disable cookie-based persistence.
    Automatically set to `'user-locale'` for the `no_prefix` strategy if not provided; an explicit
    `null` in the `i18n` config block keeps it off there too.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="localeCookieOptions" type="LocaleCookieOptions"}
    **Default** `{}` · Attributes of the locale cookie (and of the hash cookie under `hashMode`), as the server and
    the browser write it. Unset fields keep the defaults: `path: '/'`, `sameSite: 'lax'`, a year,
    no `Domain`, no `Secure`. Build config only: no request decides them.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="debug" type="boolean"}
    **Default** `false` · Enable verbose debug logging for locale detection, route generation, and translation loading.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="vueDevtools" type="boolean"}
    **Default** `true` · Register Vue DevTools inspector and timeline in dev (browser extension).
    Separate from the Nuxt DevTools custom tab.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="globalLocaleRoutes" type="GlobalLocaleRoutes"}
    **Default** `{}` · Global route-level locale configuration.
    Allows restricting or customizing locale routes for specific pages without
    modifying their components.

    - `false` — exclude the route from localization.
    - `Record<LocaleCode, string>` — custom per-locale paths.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="customRegexMatcher" type="string | RegExp"}
    **Default** `undefined (uses built-in pattern based on locale codes)` · Custom regular expression (or its string source) for matching locale codes in URL segments.
    Every locale code in `locales` must match the whole pattern, without its flags, or the build fails.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="noPrefixRedirect" type="boolean"}
    **Default** `false` · For `no_prefix` strategy: when the default locale has a custom path for a page
    (`localeRoutes` / `globalLocaleRoutes`), redirect the page's original path to the custom
    path of the visitor's locale, the default locale's otherwise (e.g. `/about` → `/about-us`).
    A locale with no custom path of its own stays on the original path. Pages with dynamic
    segments are not redirected.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="canonicalQueryWhitelist" type="string[]"}
    **Default** `['page', 'sort', 'filter', 'search', 'q', 'query', 'tag']` · List of query parameter names preserved in canonical and `og:url` meta tags.
    Parameters not in this list are stripped from the canonical URL.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="trailingSlash" type="'append' | 'remove'"}
    **Default** `undefined (inherit from Nuxt)` · Trailing slash for `$localePath` / `$switchLocalePath` (NuxtLink parity).
    Defaults to `experimental.defaults.nuxtLink.trailingSlash` when unset.
    Set explicitly to override Nuxt's link default for i18n path helpers.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="excludePatterns" type="(string | RegExp)[]"}
    **Default** `undefined` · Paths to leave out of i18n routing: a string is a path prefix (`/admin` covers `/admin/x`)
    or a `*` / `?` glob; a RegExp is tested against the path. Matching pages get no locale
    variants, no locale redirect or 404, and are dropped from prerender; they still render with
    translations. `/api`, `/_nuxt`, `/__*`, the translations route and common static files
    (sitemap, robots.txt, favicon, assets by extension) are always excluded.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="localizedRouteNamePrefix" type="string"}
    **Default** `'localized-'` · Prefix prepended to localized route names (e.g. `'localized-index'`).
    Used internally to distinguish original routes from generated locale variants.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="routeLocales" type="Record<string, string[]>"}
    Per-route locale restrictions, extracted at build time from `$defineI18nRoute()` calls.
    Maps a route path (e.g. `'/about'`) to an array of allowed locale codes.
    Routes not listed have no restrictions (all locales allowed).
    ::::

    ::::field{name="routeDisableMeta" type="Record<string, boolean | string[]>"}
    Per-route meta tag disabling. Maps a route name or path to `true` (disable all meta) or an array
    of locale codes for which meta should be disabled. Entries found in `$defineI18nRoute()`
    calls at build time are added to it.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="missingWarn" type="boolean"}
    **Default** `true` · Show console warnings when a translation key is missing (development build, in the browser).
    ::::

    ::::field{name="hmr" type="boolean"}
    **Default** `true` · Enable Hot Module Replacement for translation files in development.
    When `true`, changes to JSON translation files trigger an automatic reload
    without a full page refresh.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="cacheMaxSize" type="number"}
    **Default** `0` · Maximum number of entries in the in-memory translation caches. The fetch and server caches
    drop the least recently used entry; the browser's dictionary map drops the oldest one (FIFO).
    `0` means no limit in the browser; server caches keep at most 1000 entries then, so request
    URLs naming made-up pages cannot grow server memory.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="cacheTtl" type="number"}
    **Default** `0` · Time-to-live (in seconds) of the fetch and server translation caches, counted from when an
    entry was stored (reads do not extend it), so data from `apiBaseServerHost` is refreshed at
    least that often. The browser's active dictionaries are not expired by it. `0` means entries
    never expire.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="cacheStorage" type="string"}
    Name of a Nitro storage mount (`nitro.storage`, e.g. `'redis'`) that several server instances
    share as a dictionary cache, read after the in-process cache and before the source. Pays off
    mostly with `apiBaseServerHost`: one fetch from the backend instead of one per instance.
    Entries are keyed by build and expire after `cacheTtl`, or after one day when it is `0`.
    Off in dev and prerender. A failing storage falls back to the source. Unset: no shared cache.
    ::::

    ::::field
    ---
    name: numberFormats
    type: Record<string, Record<string, Intl.NumberFormatOptions>>
    ---
    Named number formats per locale (Vue I18n-compatible).
    Enables `$tn(1000, 'currency')` style calls.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="timeZone" type="string"}
    **Default** `the runtime's zone` · IANA time zone for `$td` and `<i18n-t date>` (`Europe/Berlin`). Set it to render one date on
    the server and in every browser; a named format's own `timeZone` wins.
    ::::

    ::::field
    ---
    name: datetimeFormats
    type: Record<string, Record<string, Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions>>
    ---
    Named datetime formats per locale (Vue I18n-compatible `datetimeFormats`).
    Enables `$td(date, 'short')` style calls.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="httpCacheDuration" type="number"}
    **Default** `31536000` · HTTP `Cache-Control` max-age (seconds) for `/{apiBaseUrl}/:page/:locale/data.json`. Applies in full only while `dateBuild` busts the URL (`?v=...`), which is the default:
    the response is then `private, max-age=…, immutable`: a browser pins it, and a CDN that ignores the query cannot
    (`public` with `httpCacheControl: false`).

    - `dateBuild: 0`/`''` — the URL is stable, so this duration is *not* honoured; the
      response becomes `public, max-age=0, must-revalidate` instead. A long `max-age` on an
      unchanging URL pins the first payload a browser ever saw.
    - `0` — do not set `Cache-Control` at all (useful in local debugging)
    - Not applied in development (`import.meta.dev`) so HMR is not fought by the browser cache
    - Reaches only responses served through Nitro. Payloads copied into `public/` and served
      by the hosting platform take that platform's headers — see the Performance guide. Analogous to `@nuxtjs/i18n` experimental `httpCacheDuration` (v10.2.0), but as an
      explicit response header rather than Nitro `defineCachedEventHandler` maxAge.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="httpCacheControl" type="string | false"}
    **Default** `'public, max-age=60'` · `Cache-Control` of a payload file answered by a host or by a path-wide rule, which cannot see `?v=`.
    On a Node server a response to the current `?v=` is pinned for `httpCacheDuration` and any other revalidates;
    with `source`, `cacheTtl` or `apiBaseServerHost`, where a dictionary changes with no build, every response takes this header.
    `false` keeps every file on `max-age=0, must-revalidate`.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="dateBuild" type="string | number"}
    Value used for cache-busting translation requests (`?v=...`). When not provided, the module uses a hash of the translation files, so the value changes
    only when translations do (`Date.now()` when no hash can be computed). `0` or `''` turns
    cache-busting off. Set a stable value (a git SHA, a build number) to pin it yourself.
    `NUXT_I18N_DATE_BUILD` or `runtimeConfig.public.i18nRuntime.dateBuild` replaces it at runtime, after a dictionary
    was replaced in place: pinned URLs are left behind, with no rebuild.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="experimental" type="Record<string, unknown>"}
    Bucket for experimental/unstable options.
    Contents may change or be removed without notice between minor versions.
    ::::
  :::
::

### `ModuleOptionsExtend`

Extended module options injected into the Nuxt runtime config.
Includes resolved values and build-time metadata.

```ts
interface ModuleOptionsExtend extends ModuleOptions
```

::collapsible{name="14 properties"}
  :::field-group
    ::::field{required name="dateBuild" type="string | number"}
    Value used for cache-busting translation requests (`?v=...`).
    ::::

    ::::field{required name="hashMode" type="boolean"}
    Whether the Nuxt app uses hash-based routing (`router.options.hashMode`).
    ::::

    ::::field{name="isSSG" type="boolean"}
    **Deprecated** — No longer set at runtime. Kept so code typed against the released module still compiles.
    ::::

    ::::field{required name="apiBaseUrl" type="string"}
    **Default** `'_locales'` · Resolved translations API base URL (after env variable / config merging).
    ::::

    ::::field{required name="disablePageLocales" type="boolean"}
    **Default** `false` · Resolved flag: whether per-page translations are disabled.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="redirects" type="boolean"}
    **Default** `true` · Resolved flag: whether locale-based redirects are enabled.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="prefixCaseRedirect" type="boolean"}
    **Default** `true` · Resolved flag: whether a locale prefix in another case or encoding redirects to its own spelling.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="translationPayloadMode" type="'premerged' | 'source'"}
    Resolved translation payload loading strategy.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="publicPayloads" type="boolean"}
    Premerged files are in `public/`, so they can sit on `app.cdnURL`.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="rootDelta" type="boolean"}
    A page's file needs its root: the browser loads the two together.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="noScripts" type="boolean"}
    Nuxt's `features.noScripts` is on: no page runs a script, so none preloads a dictionary.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="domain" type="string"}
    Host this config was resolved for (`locales[].baseUrl`); unset on any other host.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="linkLocales" type="Locale[]"}
    With `domain`: every locale, those of other domains included. `locales` holds what the host serves.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="linkDefaultLocale" type="string"}
    With `domain`: the build's `defaultLocale`, the same on every host (`x-default`). `defaultLocale` is the host's.
    ::::
  :::
::

### `PluralFunc`

Custom pluralization function.
Called when `tc()` / `$tc()` is used. Receives the key, count, params, locale,
and a getter to fetch the singular/plural forms from translations.

### `RouteI18nMeta`

`meta.i18n` that route-strategy puts on every localized record, and path-strategy reads at runtime.

```ts
interface RouteI18nMeta
```

  Base route name of the page (its translation key and the name `localeRoute({ name })` takes).
  :::

  :::field{required name="locales" type="string[]"}
  Locales this record serves.
  :::

  `disableMeta` of the page: SEO tags off in every locale (`true`) or in the listed ones.
  :::

  :::field{name="original" type="string"}
  On the default locale's record: the path of a page with a custom default path, where it is no record of its own. A link can still name the page by it.
  :::

  :::field{name="paths" type="Record<string, string>"}
  `noPrefixRedirect`, on the page's original path: the custom path of each locale. The locale is the visitor's, so the runtime redirects.
  :::

### `ScopedKey`

Helper for creating typed prefixes.
Allows safe usage of dynamic keys.

```ts
type ScopedKey<Scope extends string> = Extract<TranslationKey, `${Scope}.${string}`>
```

```ts
// Assuming keys: 'errors.404', 'errors.500', 'btn.save'
function getErrorText(code: string) {
  return t(`errors.${code}` as ScopedKey<'errors'>)
}
```

**See** [`TranslationKey`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#translationkey)

```ts
  | 'no_prefix'
  | 'prefix_except_default'
  | 'prefix'
  | 'prefix_and_default'
```

### `Translation`

A single translation value — can be a primitive, nested object, plural pair, or `unknown`.

```ts
type Translation = CleanTranslation | unknown
```

**See** [`CleanTranslation`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#cleantranslation)

### `TranslationKey`

Resolved translation key type.

- When `DefineLocaleMessage` is empty (generator not connected) — resolves to `string`.
- When `DefineLocaleMessage` has keys — resolves to a union of those keys **and**`(string & {})`, providing autocompletion while still allowing dynamic keys
  (plain `| string` would collapse the union to `string`).

```ts
type TranslationKey = Exclude<keyof DefineLocaleMessage, '__augmentation'> extends never
  ? string
  : Exclude<keyof DefineLocaleMessage, '__augmentation'> | (string & {})
```

**See** [`DefineLocaleMessage`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#definelocalemessage)

### `TranslationPayloadOptions`

```ts
interface TranslationPayloadOptions
```

::collapsible{name="9 properties"}
  :::field-group
    ::::field{name="mode" type="'premerged' | 'source'"}
    **Default** `'premerged'` · Translation payload strategy.

    - `premerged`: build-time `{page}/{locale}/data.json` matrix (default)
    - `source`: compact source files merged at runtime (prefer on Edge / large catalogs)
    ::::

    ::::field{name="serverAssets" type="boolean"}
    **Default** `true` · Local SSR payloads: a Node server that serves `public/` from disk reads that tree (forces public copy);
    Edge, function presets, and `serveStatic: "inline"` embed via Nitro `serverAssets`.

    - **Node server** (preset serves `public/` itself, e.g. `node-server`): no Nitro `serverAssets` (avoids Rollup `raw:`). SSR reads
      `public/<apiBaseUrl|publicDir>` as `{page}/{locale}/data.json`; when this is `true`,
      a public copy is forced even if `publicAssets` is false.
    - **Edge, function presets, and inline** (`nitro.node === false`, no disk `serveStatic` such as `vercel` /
      `netlify` / `aws-lambda`, or `serveStatic: "inline"` e.g. winterjs): Nitro `serverAssets` (`assets:i18n`)
      with the same layout as `mode`. Does **not** force a public copy — set `publicAssets: true` for CDN/static.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="serverHandler" type="boolean"}
    **Default** `true` · Register the built-in server route at `/{apiBaseUrl}/:page/:locale/data.json`.
    Disable this when translation payloads are served from an external host/CDN.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="publicAssets" type="boolean"}
    **Default** `true in premerged mode, false in source mode` · Copy payloads into Nitro public output. Premerged → `{page}/{locale}/data.json` under `apiBaseUrl`; source → compact tree. When SSR reads `public/` (`node-server` and similar), `serverAssets: true` also forces this copy.
    On Edge / function / `serveStatic: "inline"` presets, copy only when this is `true` (SSR uses the Nitro embed).
    ::::

    ::::field{name="prerenderRoutes" type="boolean"}
    **Default** `false` · Opt in to Nitro-prerender `/{apiBaseUrl}/.../data.json`. Usually redundant when premerged `publicAssets` already wrote those files.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="publicDir" type="string"}
    Public output folder relative to Nitro public root. Defaults to `apiBaseUrl` (`_locales`). So static files match client fetch URLs (`/{apiBaseUrl}/{page}/{locale}/data.json`).
    ::::

    ::::field{name="rootDelta" type="boolean"}
    **Default** `true` · Write one root file per locale, and in each page file only what differs from it. The client and SSR merge them;
    a whole chunk still works wherever a file is read. `false` keeps a whole dictionary in every page file.
    `premerged` only, and off with `disablePageLocales`.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="warnFileCount" type="number"}
    **Default** `500` · Warn during build when generated payload file count exceeds this threshold.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="warnSizeBytes" type="number"}
    **Default** `10485760 (10 MB)` · Warn during build when generated payload total size exceeds this threshold in bytes.
    ::::
  :::
::

# `@i18n-micro/types-generator`

Type generator for i18n-micro translation keys

Entry points: `@i18n-micro/types-generator`, `@i18n-micro/types-generator/nuxt`.

## `@i18n-micro/types-generator`

### Components

#### `I18nTypesPlugin`

A Vite (and Rollup) plugin: generates at build start, and again in dev after a locale file changes.

```ts
function I18nTypesPlugin(options: GeneratorOptions): Plugin
```

**See** [`GeneratorOptions`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#generatoroptions)

### Functions

#### `formatKeyProperty`

Emit a TS property name from a translation key.
JSON.stringify covers quotes/newlines/null bytes; U+2028/U+2029 need an extra escape
so the .d.ts stays safe when embedded in older JS tooling.

```ts
function formatKeyProperty(key: string): string
```

Generates TypeScript types for translation keys from JSON files.
Writes the result to a file.

## `@i18n-micro/types-generator/nuxt`

### Functions

#### `default`

```ts
function default(
  resolvedOptions: I18nTypesGeneratorOptions,
  nuxt: Nuxt,
```

# `@i18n-micro/utils`

Framework-agnostic utilities for Nuxt I18n Micro (granular subpath imports).

Entry points: `@i18n-micro/utils/accept-language`, `@i18n-micro/utils/active-locales`, `@i18n-micro/utils/app-path`, `@i18n-micro/utils/auto-detect-path`, `@i18n-micro/utils/cache-control`, `@i18n-micro/utils/cookie`, `@i18n-micro/utils/deep-merge`, `@i18n-micro/utils/domains`, `@i18n-micro/utils/load-dir`, `@i18n-micro/utils/locale-head`, `@i18n-micro/utils/merge-i18n-head`, `@i18n-micro/utils/merge-source`, `@i18n-micro/utils/normalize`, `@i18n-micro/utils/parse-path`, `@i18n-micro/utils/payload-fetch`, `@i18n-micro/utils/payload-url`, `@i18n-micro/utils/resolve-hreflang`, `@i18n-micro/utils/resolve-locale`, `@i18n-micro/utils/resolve-og-locale`, `@i18n-micro/utils/runtime-config`, `@i18n-micro/utils/source-loader`, `@i18n-micro/utils/split-locale-routes`.

## `@i18n-micro/utils/auto-detect-path`

### Functions

#### `shouldAttemptLocaleRedirect`

Whether cookie / Accept-Language preference may steer locale redirects (#242).

Modes (`ModuleOptions.autoDetectPath`):

- `'/'` (default) — only `/`
- `'no_prefix'` — any path without a locale prefix
- `'*'` — every path (also enables aggressive prefixed-URL rewrites in the plugin)
- any other string — that path, trailing slashes ignored

Does not gate strategy / `localeRoutes` canonicalization: when preference is denied on an
unprefixed path, the plugin still runs `getClientRedirect` with the default locale.

```ts
function shouldAttemptLocaleRedirect(
  path: string,
  options?: { autoDetectPath?: string; hasLocalePrefix?: boolean; },
): boolean
```

## `@i18n-micro/utils/cache-control`

### Classes

#### `CacheControl`

```ts
class CacheControl<T> {
  constructor(options?: CacheControlOptions)
}
```

::field-group
  :::field{name="configure" type="(options: CacheControlOptions) => void"}
  Update limits at runtime. Last call wins, and the same limits again cost nothing: the server calls this per request.
  A smaller size applies at once. A TTL applies to what is stored from then on and to entries that have none;
  an entry that already expires keeps its time, and no TTL clears them all.
  :::

:field{name="get" type="(key: string) => T | undefined"}

:field{name="has" type="(key: string) => boolean"}

:field{name="set" type="(key: string, value: T) => void"}

:field{name="delete" type="(key: string) => boolean"}

:field{name="clear" type="() => void"}

:field{name="keys" type="() => IterableIterator<string>"}

:field{name="size" type="number"}
::

**See** [`CacheControlOptions`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#cachecontroloptions)

### Types

#### `CacheControlOptions`

CacheControl — O(1) LRU cache with an optional TTL.

TTL counts from when an entry was stored, not from its last read: a hot entry still expires,
so data behind it (a remote `apiBaseServerHost`) is refreshed at least every `ttl` seconds.

Map is created internally — no external references, no desync risk.

Performance:
get — O(1) (lazy TTL check + LRU reorder via Map delete/set)
set — O(1) (LRU eviction via Map.keys().next())
has — O(1) (lazy TTL eviction)

Eviction: LRU (Least Recently Used) based on native Map insertion order.

```ts
interface CacheControlOptions
```

::field-group
:field{name="maxSize" type="number"}

  :::field{name="ttl" type="number"}
  TTL in seconds (0 = no expiration)
  :::
::

## `@i18n-micro/utils/domains`

### Functions

#### `configForHost`

`config` as `host` sees it: its default, its locales, its origin. Any other host gets `config`
itself and nothing of the request is kept or echoed: the table holds configured hosts only, one
per resolved config. A runtime config is never written to, so its table cannot go stale; the build
writes one field of its own config late (`dateBuild`, at modules\:done), and no build-time caller of
a host config reads it.

```ts
function configForHost<T extends ModuleOptionsExtend>(config: T, host: string): T
```

**See** [`ModuleOptionsExtend`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages/types#moduleoptionsextend)

#### `withHostDefaults`

`locales` with `baseDefault` on the default of every host, whether the config named it or not.

```ts
function withHostDefaults(locales: Locale[], defaultLocale: string): Locale[]
```

**See** [`Locale`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages/test-utils#locale)

### Types

#### `TranslationFile`

The one reader of a locales directory. Node only: never import it from a browser or edge entry.
Every adapter that reads the disk (node, astro, vitepress, devtools, types) agrees on what a
file is: any `*.json` under the directory, symlinks followed; broken and non-object files are
reported and skipped; a missing directory warns and reads as empty.

```ts
interface TranslationFile
```

::field-group
  :::field{required name="relativePath" type="string"}
  `/`-separated, relative to the directory: what `parseTranslationRelativePath` takes.
  :::

  :::field{required name="absolutePath" type="string"}
  :::
::

## `@i18n-micro/utils/locale-head`

### Functions

#### `buildLocaleHead`

The SEO head of a page: `lang`/`dir`, canonical, `hreflang`, `x-default` and the `og:` tags.

#### `filterQuery`

Keeps the `whitelist` query params of a path or URL and drops its hash.

```ts
function filterQuery(url: string, whitelist: readonly string[]): string
```

#### `joinBase`

`base` + `path` with one slash between them: `'/'` + `/de` or `//de` is `/de`, never the protocol-relative
`//de`. A browser reads `\` as `/` and drops a tab or a newline, so `/\host` is that form as well.

```ts
function joinBase(base: string, path: string): string
```

#### `queryString`

`?a=1&a=2` of a route's query: arrays repeat the key, `null` is a key with no value, `undefined` is left out.

```ts
function queryString(query?: object | null): string
```

::collapsible{name="11 properties"}
  :::field-group
    ::::field{required name="locale" type="Locale"}
    The current locale.
    ::::

    ::::field{required name="seoLocales" type="Locale[]"}
    Locales listed in `hreflang` and `og:locale:alternate`. Their filtering is the caller's: it alone knows the page.
    ::::

    ::::field{required name="hrefOf" type="(code: string) => string"}

    ::::

    ::::field{required name="canonical" type="string"}

    ::::

    ::::

    ::::field{name="alternates" type="boolean"}
    `false` for one URL per page (`no_prefix`): `og:locale:alternate` stays, `hreflang` and `x-default` go.
    ::::

  :field{name="addDirAttribute" type="boolean"}

    ::::field{name="addSeoAttributes" type="boolean"}
    `false` keeps `htmlAttrs` only.
    ::::

  :field{name="identifierAttribute" type="string"}

  :field{name="hreflangBaseLanguage" type="boolean"}

  :field{name="missingWarn" type="boolean"}
  :::

### Functions

#### `buildFallbackLocaleChain`

Locales whose files make up `locale`, weakest first: the global fallback, then each
`fallbackLocale` link followed to its end (fr → de → en is `[en, de, fr]`), then the locale.

#### `mergeOverRoot`

A page's tree from its root and its delta, as a deep merge makes it: objects merge, anything else replaces. Only the
nodes on the delta's paths are new, the rest is the root's, and the delta is taken as it is: a parsed file has no other
owner, and copying a large one costs what parsing it did. A stored tree is never written to.

```ts
function mergeOverRoot(
  root: Record<string, unknown>,
  delta: Record<string, unknown>,
): Record<string, unknown>
```

#### `PREMERGED_ROOT_MARK`

Own key of a premerged file: the root file's content hash, in the root and in every delta made against it.
A file without it is a whole chunk (dev, `source`, the server route, a host's older files) and stands alone.

```ts

```

Premerged payload of the root dictionary alone (with fallbacks): what a page without its own
`pages/<name>/` folder shows, instead of an empty dictionary.

```ts
const PREMERGED_ROOT_PAGE: "__root"
```

#### `pagePathSegmentsToRouteName`

Convert nested page path segments to a route name (e.g. `user/profile` → `user-profile`).

```ts
function pagePathSegmentsToRouteName(segments: string[]): string | null
```

#### `parseTranslationRelativePath`

Parse a translation file path relative to the locales root.
Examples: `en.json`, `pages/about/en.json`, `pages/user/profile/en.json`
A `__proto__` page or locale is ignored: as a bucket key it would write the prototype.

```ts
function parseTranslationRelativePath(
  relativePath: string,
): ParsedTranslationRelativePath
```

**See** [`ParsedTranslationRelativePath`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#parsedtranslationrelativepath)

```ts
  translations: T,
  disablePageLocales?: boolean,
```

## `@i18n-micro/utils/payload-url`

### Functions

#### `buildTranslationPayloadCacheControl`

Builds `Cache-Control` for `/{apiBaseUrl}/:page/:locale/data.json`.

`immutable` is only emitted when a cache-buster is active (`hasCacheBuster`),
i.e. requests carry `?v=<dateBuild>`. Without a cache-buster (`dateBuild` set
to `0`/`''`) the URL is stable across deploys, so we intentionally avoid
long-lived caching by returning a conservative `max-age=0` policy.

Returns `null` when caching should be skipped — non-positive or non-finite
`duration` (guards `NaN`/`Infinity` from producing a malformed header).

```ts
function buildTranslationPayloadCacheControl(
  durationSeconds: number | undefined,
  hasCacheBuster?: boolean,
): string | null
```

#### `buildTranslationPayloadFetchRequest`

```ts
function buildTranslationPayloadFetchRequest(
  input: TranslationPayloadFetchRequestInput,
): { path: string; baseURL: string; params?: Record<string, string | number>; }
```

**See** [`TranslationPayloadFetchRequestInput`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#translationpayloadfetchrequestinput)

#### `buildTranslationPayloadPath`

```ts
function buildTranslationPayloadPath(
  apiBaseUrl: string,
  page: string,
  locale: string,
): string
```

#### `resolveTranslationPayloadBaseURL`

```ts
function resolveTranslationPayloadBaseURL(
  options: {
    isServer: boolean;
    baseURL: string;
    apiBaseClientHost?: string;
    apiBaseServerHost?: string;
  },
): string
```

#### `resolveTranslationPayloadCachePolicy`

The URL with the current `v` is the version-pinned one, like a hashed asset. `private`: a CDN that ignores the query
must not answer the next `v` from this response, and pin an old dictionary in a browser for a year.
An old `v` stays servable, as cached HTML still names it, and revalidates. A file header is path-wide, so it stays short.

```ts
function resolveTranslationPayloadCachePolicy(
  input: TranslationPayloadCacheInput,
): TranslationPayloadCachePolicy
```

**See** [`TranslationPayloadCacheInput`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#translationpayloadcacheinput) · [`TranslationPayloadCachePolicy`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#translationpayloadcachepolicy)

#### `resolveTranslationPayloadPage`

```ts
function resolveTranslationPayloadPage(
  routeName: string | undefined,
  routesLocaleLinks?: Record<string, string>,
): string
```

### Constants

#### `TRANSLATION_PAYLOAD_FILE_CACHE_CONTROL`

What a path-wide header can promise: it cannot see `?v=`, so a host's copy stays short.
No `stale-while-revalidate`: past `max-age`, which a CDN's `Age` reaches on a first visit, Chromium revalidates a fetch() or a
preload of this file with a loader that never reads the body, so that request is never reported finished and `networkidle` never comes.

```ts
const TRANSLATION_PAYLOAD_FILE_CACHE_CONTROL: "public, max-age=60"
```

### Types

#### `TranslationPayloadCacheInput`

```ts
interface TranslationPayloadCacheInput
```

::field-group
:field{name="httpCacheDuration" type="number"}

  :::field{name="httpCacheControl" type="string | false"}
  The header of a file a host answers. `false`: the policy from before `?v=` decided it: revalidate every file.
  :::

:field{name="dateBuild" type="string | number"}

  :::field{name="live" type="boolean"}
  The dictionary can change with no build (`source`, `cacheTtl`, a payload host): `v` does not follow it, so nothing is pinned.
  :::
::

#### `TranslationPayloadCachePolicy`

```ts
interface TranslationPayloadCachePolicy
```

::field-group
  :::field{required name="file" type="string | null"}
  Path-wide: the route rule, and with it `_headers` and a host's config.
  :::

  :::field{required name="current" type="string | null"}
  A response to the current `?v=`, where something sees the query.
  :::

  :::field{required name="stale" type="string | null"}
  A response to an old `?v=`, or none.
  :::

## `@i18n-micro/utils/resolve-locale`

### Functions

#### `explicitLocale`

The first valid explicit source: url → query (query → url with `queryFirst`) → state → cookie;
null when none is valid. An invalid value never hides a valid one after it.

```ts
function explicitLocale(input: Omit<ResolveLocaleInput, 'defaultLocale'>): string | null
```

**See** [`ResolveLocaleInput`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#resolvelocaleinput)

#### `firstQueryValue`

A query value as one locale candidate: `?locale=a&locale=b` is `a`.

```ts
function firstQueryValue(value: unknown): string | null
```

#### `localeFromPath`

Locale code in the first path segment, or null.

```ts
function localeFromPath(path: string, validLocales: readonly string[]): string | null
```

#### `preferenceCounts`

Whether cookie, state and Accept-Language decide this URL's redirect.

```ts
function preferenceCounts(
  input: Pick<RedirectLocaleInput, 'path' | 'urlLocale' | 'autoDetectPath' | 'alwaysPrefixed'>,
): boolean
```

**See** [`RedirectLocaleInput`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#redirectlocaleinput)

#### `redirectLocale`

The locale a locale redirect aims at: `resolveLocale` over state → cookie → Accept-Language
wherever `autoDetectPath` lets preference count (`'*'`: every path), and on every unprefixed URL
under `prefix`. Elsewhere an unprefixed URL keeps the default locale, so it still canonicalizes
(`localeRoutes` aliases). The URL is not a source here: it is what the redirect may move.

```ts
function redirectLocale(input: RedirectLocaleInput): string
```

**See** [`RedirectLocaleInput`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#redirectlocaleinput)

#### `resolveLocale`

The one precedence: `explicitLocale`, then Accept-Language (only with `autoDetectLanguage` and
no explicit source), then the default.

```ts
function resolveLocale(input: ResolveLocaleInput): string
```

**See** [`ResolveLocaleInput`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#resolvelocaleinput)

### Types

#### `RedirectLocaleInput`

```ts
interface RedirectLocaleInput extends Omit<ResolveLocaleInput, 'url' | 'query' | 'queryFirst'>
```

::field-group
  :::field{required name="path" type="string"}
  :::

  :::field{required name="urlLocale" type="string | null"}
  Locale prefix of `path`, or null.
  :::

  :::field{name="autoDetectPath" type="string"}
  `ModuleOptions.autoDetectPath` (default `'/'`).
  :::

  :::field{name="alwaysPrefixed" type="boolean"}
  `prefix`: no page has an unprefixed URL, so such a URL always takes the preference.
  :::
::

**See** [`ResolveLocaleInput`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#resolvelocaleinput)

#### `ResolveLocaleInput`

Every source a caller may have for the locale of a request or navigation. A caller passes only
the sources it has (and is allowed to use); the order between them lives here only.

```ts
interface ResolveLocaleInput
```

::collapsible{name="9 properties"}
  :::field-group
    ::::field{required name="defaultLocale" type="string"}
    ::::

    ::::field{required name="validLocales" type="readonly string[]"}
    ::::

  :field{name="autoDetectLanguage" type="boolean"}

    ::::field{name="url" type="string | null"}
    Locale prefix of the URL, as the routing strategy reads it.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="query" type="string | null"}
    `?locale=` — only where the caller honours it (no_prefix pages, server API helpers).
    ::::

    ::::field{name="state" type="string | null"}
    A locale the app chose (`useState('i18n-locale')`).
    ::::

  :field{name="cookie" type="string | null"}

  :field{name="acceptLanguage" type="string | null"}

    ::::field{name="queryFirst" type="boolean"}
    `?locale=` before the URL: the documented order of the server API helpers.
    ::::
  :::
::

## `@i18n-micro/utils/runtime-config`

### Functions

#### `applyI18nRuntimeOverrides`

The build config with runtime overrides applied. Runtime `disabledLocales` add to the
build-time disabled ones (a locale disabled at build has no payloads to re-enable);
`defaultLocale` and `fallbackLocale` must be enabled. No env reads: see `readI18nEnvOverrides`.
When nothing changes, the build config itself is returned (a disabled build default is still replaced).

```ts
function applyI18nRuntimeOverrides<T extends ModuleOptionsExtend>(
  baseConfig: T,
  requested: RuntimeI18nOverrides,
  warn?: (message: string) => void,
): T
```

**See** [`ModuleOptionsExtend`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages/types#moduleoptionsextend) · [`RuntimeI18nOverrides`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#runtimei18noverrides)

#### `applyLocaleBaseUrls`

`config` with the runtime `locales[].baseUrl`s, after `applyI18nRuntimeOverrides`. A build without
locale domains has no routing for them (the path strategy is chosen at build): ignored there, like
`strategy`. Apart, so that a browser bundle without domains drops it. `metaBaseUrl` stays: who moves the
default locale's domain sets `NUXT_I18N_META_BASE_URL` too.

```ts
function applyLocaleBaseUrls<T extends ModuleOptionsExtend>(
  config: T,
  overrides: RuntimeI18nOverrides,
  warn?: (message: string) => void,
): T
```

**See** [`ModuleOptionsExtend`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages/types#moduleoptionsextend) · [`RuntimeI18nOverrides`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#runtimei18noverrides)

#### `createI18nConfigResolver`

`applyI18nRuntimeOverrides` with `runtimeConfig.public.i18nRuntime` first, then env vars, memoized
for one process: env is read once, and the same config object answers while the base config and the overrides are unchanged (so warnings
are logged once). That object is shared by every request: in dev it is deep-frozen, so a
mutation throws instead of leaking into later requests.

```ts
function createI18nConfigResolver(
  warn?: (message: string) => void,
): <T extends ModuleOptionsExtend>(baseConfig: T, runtimePublic?: Record<string, unknown>) => T
```

**See** [`ModuleOptionsExtend`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages/types#moduleoptionsextend)

#### `i18nOverridesKey`

A stable string of the overrides: equal strings resolve to equal configs.

```ts
function i18nOverridesKey(overrides: RuntimeI18nOverrides): string
```

**See** [`RuntimeI18nOverrides`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#runtimei18noverrides)

#### `mergeI18nOverrides`

`primary`'s values, `secondary`'s where `primary` has none.

```ts
function mergeI18nOverrides(
  primary: RuntimeI18nOverrides,
  secondary: RuntimeI18nOverrides,
): RuntimeI18nOverrides
```

**See** [`RuntimeI18nOverrides`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#runtimei18noverrides)

#### `readI18nEnvOverrides`

Overrides from `NUXT_I18N_*` / `NUXT_PUBLIC_I18N_RUNTIME_*` env vars (server only: the browser has no env).

```ts
function readI18nEnvOverrides(): RuntimeI18nOverrides
```

**See** [`RuntimeI18nOverrides`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#runtimei18noverrides)

#### `readI18nRuntimeOverrides`

Overrides from `runtimeConfig.public.i18nRuntime`.

```ts
function readI18nRuntimeOverrides(
  runtimePublic?: Record<string, unknown>,
): RuntimeI18nOverrides
```

**See** [`RuntimeI18nOverrides`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#runtimei18noverrides)

#### `readLocaleBaseUrls`

`runtimeConfig.public.i18nRuntime.localeBaseUrls`. Apart from `readI18nRuntimeOverrides`: only a build with
locale domains reads it, so a browser bundle without them drops the parser.

```ts
function readLocaleBaseUrls(
  runtimePublic?: Record<string, unknown>,
): Record<string, string> | undefined
```

## `@i18n-micro/utils/split-locale-routes`

### Functions

#### `splitLocaleRoutes`

Split one programmatic route registry into Nuxt pages + `globalLocaleRoutes` (#244).

Keeps both halves in sync and keys locale paths by route **name** (not file path),
so N routes sharing one wrapper SFC do not overwrite each other.

```ts
function splitLocaleRoutes(
  entries: readonly SplitLocaleRouteEntry[],
): SplitLocaleRoutesResult
```

**See** [`SplitLocaleRouteEntry`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#splitlocalerouteentry) · [`SplitLocaleRoutesResult`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#splitlocaleroutesresult)

### Types

#### `SplitLocaleRouteEntry`

One programmatic route entry for `splitLocaleRoutes` (#244).
Prefer route `name` as the `globalLocaleRoutes` key so shared wrapper SFCs do not collapse.

```ts
interface SplitLocaleRouteEntry
```

::field-group
  :::field{required name="name" type="string"}
  Route name — also the key in `globalLocaleRoutes`.
  :::

  :::field{required name="path" type="string"}
  Default (unlocalized) path pushed into `pages:extend`.
  :::

  :::field{required name="file" type="string"}
  Page component / wrapper SFC (Nuxt `file`).
  :::

  :::field{name="paths" type="Record<LocaleCode, string> | false"}
  Custom per-locale paths, or `false` to disable localization for this route.
  Omitted → route is still pushed to `pages`, but no `globalLocaleRoutes` entry.
  :::
::

# `@i18n-micro/vitepress`

VitePress bindings for i18n-micro — runtime dictionaries, MD components, and locale switcher.

Entry points: `@i18n-micro/vitepress`, `@i18n-micro/vitepress/config`, `@i18n-micro/vitepress/node`, `@i18n-micro/vitepress/theme`.

## `@i18n-micro/vitepress`

### Functions

#### `createI18n`

Universal VitePress i18n: Vue plugin + path helpers + `enhanceApp` sync.
Path methods are the router adapter’s own functions (no wrapper layer).

```ts
function createI18n(options: CreateI18nOptions): CreateI18nResult
```

**See** [`CreateI18nOptions`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#createi18noptions) · [`CreateI18nResult`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#createi18nresult)

#### `getLocaleFromPath`

Detect i18n locale code from a URL path (prefix_except_default).
Path prefixes are VitePress locale keys; return value is the i18n code.
Pass `base` when the path may include VitePress `site.base` (SSG).

```ts
function getLocaleFromPath(
  path: string,
  localeCodes: string[],
  defaultLocale: string,
  localeKeyToCode?: Record<string, string>,
  base?: string,
): string
```

#### `messagesFromGlob`

Tiny helper if you still prefer `import.meta.glob` instead of `defineI18nTheme`.
Only unwraps Vite module namespaces — dictionaries with a `default` key stay intact.

```ts
function messagesFromGlob(
  modules: Record<string, { default: Translations; } | Translations>,
): Record<string, Translations>
```

**See** [`Translations`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages/types#translations)

#### `routeNameFromPath`

Route name for page-scoped dictionaries (`/guide/demo` → `guide-demo`).
Strips VitePress URL prefixes (keys), not only raw i18n codes.

When `defaultLocale` is omitted (legacy 2-arg call), any segment that matches a
listed locale code is stripped — callers must not rely on `localeCodes[0]` as default.

```ts
function routeNameFromPath(
  path: string,
  localeCodes: string[],
  defaultLocale?: string,
  localeKeyToCode?: Record<string, string>,
  base?: string,
): string
```

#### `stripSiteBase`

Strip VitePress `site.base` from a path. Leaves query/hash intact.
No-op when `base` is missing or `/`.

```ts
function stripSiteBase(path: string, base?: string): string
```

### Types

#### `CreateI18nOptions`

```ts
interface CreateI18nOptions
```

::collapsible{name="15 properties"}
  :::field-group
    ::::field{required name="locale" type="string"}
    ::::

  :field{name="fallbackLocale" type="string"}

  :field{name="locales" type="Locale[]"}

  :field{name="defaultLocale" type="string"}

  :field{name="messages" type="Record<string, Translations>"}

    ::::field
    ---
    name: routeMessages
    type: Record<string, Record<string, Translations>>
    ---
    Page-scoped dictionaries keyed by route name (`guide-demo`), then locale.
    Loaded from `locales/pages/**` when using `withI18n`.
    ::::

  :field{name="plural" type="PluralFunc"}

  :field{name="missingWarn" type="boolean"}

  :field{name="numberFormats" type="VueI18nOptions['numberFormats']"}

  :field{name="datetimeFormats" type="VueI18nOptions['datetimeFormats']"}

  :field{name="timeZone" type="string"}

  :field{name="missingHandler" type="(locale: string, key: string, routeName: string) => void"}

    ::::field{name="syncWithVitePress" type="boolean"}
    **Default** `true` · Sync i18n locale from the VitePress URL path on every navigation.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="localeKeyToCode" type="Record<string, string>"}
    Map VitePress locale keys to i18n codes (`root` → default locale code).
    ::::

    ::::field{name="base" type="string"}
    VitePress `site.base`. Needed so SSG paths (`withBase`) and lang switcher
    do not treat the base segment as content / double-prefix links.
    ::::
  :::
::

#### `VitePressUserConfigLike`

Minimal VitePress / Vite user config shape we merge into.

```ts
interface VitePressUserConfigLike
```

:field{name="transformPageData" type="(...args: any[]) => any"}

#### `WithI18nOptions`

```ts
interface WithI18nOptions extends CreateI18nOptions
```

::field-group
  :::field{name="translationDir" type="string"}
  **Default** `'locales'` · Directory with locale JSON (`en.json`, `pages/guide/demo/en.json`, …), relative to Vite root
  (VitePress content / docs root). Used by `virtual:i18n-micro/messages`.
  :::

  :::field{name="disablePageLocales" type="boolean"}
  **Default** `false` · When true, treat `pages/**` as root-level dictionaries.
  :::

  :::field{name="warnOnLocaleMismatch" type="boolean"}
  **Default** `true` · When true, logs a warning if VitePress `locales` keys do not align with
  configured i18n locale codes.
  :::

  :::field{name="i18nRouting" type="boolean"}
  **Default** `true` · Inject `themeConfig.i18nRouting` from adapter options + `config.base`.
  Set `false` to skip. Skipped automatically when `themeConfig.i18nRouting` is already set.
  :::

  :::field{name="meta" type="boolean"}
  **Default** ``true when `metaBaseUrl` is set, otherwise false`` · Emit i18n SEO tags via `transformHead` (canonical, hreflang, og\:locale…) —
  Nuxt `meta` / plugin `02.meta` analogue.
  Absolute link tags require `metaBaseUrl`.
  :::

  :::field{name="metaBaseUrl" type="string"}
  Public origin without trailing slash (`https://example.com`).
  Same role as Nuxt `metaBaseUrl`.
  :::

  :::field{name="hreflangBaseLanguage" type="boolean"}
  **Default** `false` · Also emit bare-language hreflang from `iso` (Nuxt `hreflangBaseLanguage`).
  :::

  :::field{name="canonicalQueryWhitelist" type="string[]"}
  **Default** `[]` · Query keys kept on canonical / alternate URLs.
  :::
::

**See** [`CreateI18nOptions`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#createi18noptions)

## `@i18n-micro/vitepress/config`

Also exports, as `@i18n-micro/vitepress` does: [`VirtualI18nConfig`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#virtuali18nconfig) · [`VitePressUserConfigLike`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#vitepressuserconfiglike) · [`WithI18nOptions`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#withi18noptions).

### Functions

#### `buildVitePressLocaleHead`

Build i18n SEO head for VitePress — same tags as Nuxt `useLocaleHead` /
plugin `02.meta` (canonical, hreflang, x-default, og\:locale / og\:url / alternates).

Framework-agnostic pure function; wired automatically by `withI18n` when `meta` is on.

```ts
function buildVitePressLocaleHead(
  options: BuildVitePressLocaleHeadOptions,
): VitePressLocaleHeadObject
```

**See** [`BuildVitePressLocaleHeadOptions`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#buildvitepresslocaleheadoptions) · [`VitePressLocaleHeadObject`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#vitepresslocaleheadobject)

#### `buildVitePressLocales`

Build VitePress `config.locales` from i18n-micro `Locale[]`.
Default locale becomes `root` (no URL prefix); others get `/{key}/`.

```ts
function buildVitePressLocales(
  locales: Locale[],
  defaultLocale: string,
  options?: BuildVitePressLocalesOptions,
): Record<string, VitePressLocaleEntry>
```

**See** [`Locale`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages/types#locale) · [`BuildVitePressLocalesOptions`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#buildvitepresslocalesoptions) · [`VitePressLocaleEntry`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#vitepresslocaleentry)

#### `relativePathToRoutePath`

Convert VitePress `pageData.relativePath` to a route path (cleanUrls-style).

```ts
function relativePathToRoutePath(relativePath: string): string
```

#### `warnLocaleMismatch`

```ts
function warnLocaleMismatch(
  config: VitePressUserConfigLike,
  options: WithI18nOptions,
): void
```

**See** [`VitePressUserConfigLike`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#vitepressuserconfiglike) · [`WithI18nOptions`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#withi18noptions)

#### `withI18n`

VitePress config helper: virtual modules + optional `i18nRouting` / SEO head.

Registers:

- `virtual:i18n-micro/config`
- `virtual:i18n-micro/messages` (from `translationDir`, default `locales/`)

By default also sets `themeConfig.i18nRouting` (pass `i18nRouting: false` to skip).
Pair with `defineI18nTheme(DefaultTheme)` from `@i18n-micro/vitepress/theme`.
Import from `@i18n-micro/vitepress/config` (Node / config files only).

```ts
function withI18n<T extends VitePressUserConfigLike>(
  config: T,
  options: WithI18nOptions,
): T
```

**See** [`VitePressUserConfigLike`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#vitepressuserconfiglike) · [`WithI18nOptions`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#withi18noptions)

## `@i18n-micro/vitepress/theme`

### Functions

#### `defineI18nTheme`

Zero-boilerplate theme wiring. Requires `withI18n(...)` in `.vitepress/config`
so virtual config + messages modules exist.

Uses **static** `virtual:i18n-micro/*` imports so VitePress SSG can rewrite them.
Import this helper from `@i18n-micro/vitepress/theme` (not the root entry) so Node
config evaluation never loads virtual modules.

```ts
function defineI18nTheme<T extends Theme>(base: T, options?: DefineI18nThemeOptions): T
```

```ts
import DefaultTheme from 'vitepress/theme'
import { defineI18nTheme } from '@i18n-micro/vitepress/theme'

export default defineI18nTheme(DefaultTheme)
```

**See** [`DefineI18nThemeOptions`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/#definei18nthemeoptions)

```ts
interface DefineI18nThemeOptions
```

    ::::field{name="enhanceApp" type="NonNullable<Theme['enhanceApp']>"}

    ::::

    ::::field{name="plural" type="PluralFunc"}
    Overrides for this theme: `plural` and `missingHandler` cannot be serialized into
    `virtual:i18n-micro/config`; the formats and `timeZone` default to what `withI18n` got.

    ::::

    ::::field
    ---
    required: true
    name: mergeTranslations
    type: "(locale: string, routeName: string, translations: Translations) => void"
    ---
    ::::

    ::::field{required name="clearCache" type="() => void"}
    ::::
  :::
::

#### `I18nRouteTarget`

A link target: a path with its query and hash, or a location (a named one needs a router that resolves names).

```ts
type I18nRouteTarget = string | {
  path?: string;
  name?: string | symbol;
  params?: object;
  query?: object;
  hash?: string;
}
```

#### `I18nRoutingStrategy`

Routing strategy interface for i18n
Implement this interface to integrate with any router library

```ts
interface I18nRoutingStrategy
```

::field-group
  :::field{required name="getCurrentPath" type="() => string"}
  Returns current path (without locale prefix if needed, or full path)
  Used for determining active classes in links
  :::

  :::field{name="linkComponent" type="string | Component"}
  Component to use for rendering links (e.g., RouterLink)
  :::

  :::field{required name="push" type="(target: { path: string; }) => void"}
  Function to navigate to another route/locale
  :::

  :::field{required name="replace" type="(target: { path: string; }) => void"}
  Function to replace current route
  :::

  :::field
  ---
  name: resolvePath
  type: "(to: I18nRouteTarget, locale: string) => string | { path?: string; }"
  ---
  Generate path for specific locale
  :::

  :::field{name="toHref" type="(path: string) => string"}
  `href` of a path from `resolvePath`, for a router that navigates by something else
  (VitePress: paths are relative to the site base, the address bar is not)
  :::

  :::field
  ---
  name: getRoute
  type: "() => { fullPath: string; query: Record<string, unknown>; }"
  ---
  (Optional) Get current route object for SEO/Meta tags
  :::
::

# `<i18n-group>`

`<i18n-group>` scopes a block of markup to one key prefix. Use it when many keys of a section share a prefix and you do not want to repeat it. The default slot receives a `t` that prepends the prefix.

## Props and slot

::field-group
  :::field{required name="prefix" type="string"}
  Key prefix every lookup inside the slot is resolved against.
  :::

  :::field{name="groupClass" type="string"}
  **Default** `''` · Extra class on the wrapper element.
  :::
::

### Slots

::field-group
  :::field{name="default"}
  Receives `prefix` and a `t` function scoped to it.

  **Bindings** `prefix`, `t`
  :::
::

## Behaviour

- Renders `<div class="i18n-group {groupClass}">` around the slot.
- `t(key, params)` is `$t(prefix + '.' + key, params)` for the current route.
- Only the slot's `t` is scoped: `$t` and nested `<i18n-t>` inside the group still take full keys.

## Example

```json
{
  "checkout": { "title": "Checkout", "items": "Items: {count}" }
}
```

```vue
<template>
  <i18n-group prefix="checkout" group-class="checkout">
    <template #default="{ t }">
      <h2>{{ t('title') }}</h2>
      <p>{{ t('items', { count: 3 }) }}</p>
    </template>
  </i18n-group>
</template>
```

## Related

::card-group
:card{icon="i-lucide-braces" title="$t" to="https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/methods#t"}

:card{icon="i-lucide-component" title="<i18n-t>" to="https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/components/i18n-t"}
::


# `<i18n-link>`

`<i18n-link>` renders a `NuxtLink` to `to` in the active locale. Use it instead of `<NuxtLink :to="$localePath(...)">` in templates. An external URL becomes a plain `<a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">`.

## Props

::field-group
  :::field
  ---
  required: true
  name: to
  type: RouteLocationNamedRaw | RouteLocationResolvedGeneric | string
  ---
  Target route. Localized automatically; an external URL is passed through unchanged.
  :::

  :::field{name="activeStyle" type="CSSProperties"}
  Inline style applied while the link points at the current route.
  :::
::

### Slots

::field-group
  :::field{name="default"}
  Link content.
  :::
::

## Behaviour

- `to` goes through [`$localePath`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/methods#localepath): a path, a named route or a route object, with custom locale paths applied.
- External: a string starting with `http://`, `https://` or `//`, a bare domain (`example.com`), or a `tel:` / `mailto:` link. A bare domain gets `https://`, and any slash-less dotted string counts as one: write a local file as `/report.pdf`, not `report.pdf`.
- Active: when the current `route.path` equals the localized path (query and hash ignored), `activeStyle` is applied. There is no active class and no default active style.
- Other attributes (`class`, `aria-*`) fall through to the link.

## Example

```vue
<template>
  <i18n-link to="/about" :active-style="{ fontWeight: 'bold' }">{{ $t('nav.about') }}</i18n-link>
  <i18n-link :to="{ name: 'blog-slug', params: { slug: 'hello' } }">{{ $t('nav.post') }}</i18n-link>
  <i18n-link to="https://github.com/s00d/nuxt-i18n-micro">GitHub</i18n-link>
</template>
```

## Related

::card-group
:card{icon="i-lucide-braces" title="$localePath" to="https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/methods#localepath"}

  :::card
  ---
  icon: i-lucide-component
  title: <i18n-switcher>
  to: https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/components/i18n-switcher
  ---
  Links to the current page in other locales
  :::
::


# `<i18n-switcher>`

`<i18n-switcher>` renders a button with the active locale and a dropdown of all enabled locales, including the active one. Use it for a ready-made language menu; build your own from [`$getLocales`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/methods#getlocales) and [`$switchLocalePath`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/methods#switchlocalepath) when you need different markup. Each entry links to the current page in that locale.

## Props and slots

::collapsible{name="9 props"}
  :::field-group
    ::::field{name="customLabels" type="Record<string, string>"}
    **Default** `() => ({})` · Display name per locale code, overriding the `displayName` from the locale config.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="customWrapperStyle" type="CSSProperties"}
    **Default** `() => ({})` · Inline style for the outer wrapper.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="customButtonStyle" type="CSSProperties"}
    **Default** `() => ({})` · Inline style for the button that opens the dropdown.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="customDropdownStyle" type="CSSProperties"}
    **Default** `() => ({})` · Inline style for the dropdown panel.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="customItemStyle" type="CSSProperties"}
    **Default** `() => ({})` · Inline style for each item in the dropdown.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="customLinkStyle" type="CSSProperties"}
    **Default** `() => ({})` · Inline style for the link inside an item.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="customActiveLinkStyle" type="CSSProperties"}
    **Default** `() => ({})` · Inline style for the link of the currently active locale.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="customDisabledLinkStyle" type="CSSProperties"}
    **Default** `() => ({})` · Inline style for the *current* locale button when it is `disabled: true` in config.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="customIconStyle" type="CSSProperties"}
    **Default** `() => ({})` · Inline style for the caret icon on the button.
    ::::
  :::
::

### Slots

::collapsible{name="11 slots"}
  :::field-group
    ::::field{name="before-button"}
    Content before the button that opens the dropdown.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="before-selected-locale"}
    Content before the active locale label inside the button.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="after-selected-locale"}
    Content after the active locale label inside the button.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="before-dropdown"}
    Content between the button and the dropdown panel.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="before-dropdown-items"}
    Content at the top of the dropdown, above the locale list.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="before-item"}
    Content before each locale entry.

    **Bindings** `locale`
    ::::

    ::::field{name="before-link-content"}
    Content before a locale's label inside its link.

    **Bindings** `locale`
    ::::

    ::::field{name="after-link-content"}
    Content after a locale's label inside its link.

    **Bindings** `locale`
    ::::

    ::::field{name="after-item"}
    Content after each locale entry.

    **Bindings** `locale`
    ::::

    ::::field{name="after-dropdown-items"}
    Content at the bottom of the dropdown, below the locale list.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="after-dropdown"}
    Content after the dropdown panel.
    ::::
  :::
::

## Behaviour

- Lists every locale without `disabled: true`, the active one included.
- Each entry is an `<a>` to `$switchLocalePath(code)`. A path resolves under `app.baseURL`; a locale `baseUrl` on another domain stays absolute. It has `hreflang` and `lang` set to `iso || code`, `dir` when the locale has one, `aria-current="page"` on the current locale, and class `switcher-locale-<code>`. A click calls `$switchLocale(code)` and closes the dropdown; with a modifier key it is left to the browser.
- The list stays in the server HTML, hidden, so crawlers see the links. Escape or a click outside closes it.
- Label: `customLabels[code]`, then the locale's `displayName`, then the code (with a dev warning).
- Styles: small inline defaults (bordered white button and panel, the active entry bold and blue). Each `custom*Style` prop is applied after the default of its part. The button has the classes `i18n-switcher-button` and `language-switcher`, the wrapper `i18n-switcher-wrapper`, the list `i18n-switcher-dropdown`. Positions use logical CSS properties, so `dir="rtl"` works.

## Example

```vue
<template>
  <i18n-switcher
    :custom-labels="{ en: 'English', de: 'Deutsch' }"
    :custom-button-style="{ borderRadius: '4px' }"
  >
    <template #before-link-content="{ locale }">
      <img :src="`/flags/${locale.code}.svg`" alt="" width="16" />
    </template>
  </i18n-switcher>
</template>
```

## Related

::card-group
:card{icon="i-lucide-braces" title="$switchLocale" to="https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/methods#switchlocale"}

:card{icon="i-lucide-component" title="<i18n-link>" to="https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/components/i18n-link"}
::


# `<i18n-t>`

`<i18n-t>` renders one translation into an element. Use it when a translation needs components inside it (a link in a sentence), a plural form, or a formatted number or date. It resolves the key for the current route, like `$t`.

## Props

::collapsible{name="11 props"}
  :::field-group
    ::::field{required name="keypath" type="string"}
    Translation key to render.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="plural" type="number | string | null"}
    Count selecting the plural form. Set it to use `$tc` instead of `$t`. `null` means unset.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="tag" type="string"}
    **Default** `'span'` · Element to render.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="params" type="Record<string, string | number | boolean>"}
    Interpolation values substituted into the translation.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="defaultValue" type="string"}
    **Default** `''` · Rendered instead of the component when `hideIfEmpty` suppresses an empty translation.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="html" type="boolean"}
    **Default** `false` · Render the translation as HTML rather than text. Only for translations you control: `params` are escaped, the translation is not.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="hideIfEmpty" type="boolean"}
    **Default** `false` · Render nothing when the translation resolves to an empty string.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="customPluralRule" type="PluralFunc"}
    **Default** `null` · Plural rule for this element only, overriding the configured one. Its answer is used as is; `null` renders empty.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="number" type="number | string | null"}
    Formats the value with `$tn` and passes it to the translation as `{number}`, alongside `params`.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="date" type="Date | string | number | null"}
    Formats the value with `$td` and passes it to the translation as `{date}`, alongside `params`.
    ::::

    ::::field{name="relativeDate" type="Date | string | number | null"}
    Formats the value with `$tdr` and passes it to the translation as `{relativeDate}`, alongside `params`.
    ::::
  :::
::

## Rendering rules

The first matching case decides the output:

1. `number` — the translation with `{ ...params, number: $tn(number) }`.
2. `date` — the translation with `{ ...params, date: $td(date) }`.
3. `relativeDate` — the translation with `{ ...params, relativeDate: $tdr(relativeDate) }`.
4. `plural` — the form `$tc` picks, the [`=0 `marker](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/methods#tc) included, with `{ ...params, count }`; or `customPluralRule(keypath, count, params, locale, t)` when set, which reads the raw value, marker included, and whose answer is used as is, `null` being empty.
5. Otherwise the translation with `params`.

`null` counts as not set. In every case:

- `defaultValue` stands in for a missing key, in every branch.
- `hideIfEmpty` renders `defaultValue` instead of a blank result.
- `html` renders the result as HTML. `params` are escaped, the translation is not; slots are ignored.
- A `default` slot receives `{ translation }`, and named slots are ignored.
- Otherwise each named slot replaces every `{name}` placeholder, before a param of that name. A param value that looks like a placeholder stays text.

`date` and `relativeDate` output carries `data-allow-mismatch="text"`, because the server's time zone and clock are not the browser's. Set [`timeZone`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/module-options#timezone) to render one calendar date in both; `relativeDate` depends on the clock, so it can still differ.

## Example

```json
{
  "terms": "I accept the {link}.",
  "termsLink": "terms of use",
  "items": "no items | one item | {count} items"
}
```

```vue
<template>
  <i18n-t keypath="terms" tag="p">
    <template #link>
      <NuxtLink :to="$localePath('/terms')">{{ $t('termsLink') }}</NuxtLink>
    </template>
  </i18n-t>

  <i18n-t keypath="items" :plural="cart.length" />
</template>
```

`html` sets `innerHTML`: use it only for translations you control. `params` are escaped, so user data is safe there, and so is a key that found no translation.

  :::card
  ---
  icon: i-lucide-braces
  title: Helpers
  to: https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/methods#tc
  ---
  `$t`, `$tc`, `$tn`, `$td`, `$tdr`
  :::

  :::card
  ---
  icon: i-lucide-braces
  title: plural
  to: https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/module-options#plural
  ---
  The app-wide plural rule
  :::
::


# `useI18n`

`useI18n()` returns the module's runtime helpers as a plain object. Use it in `<script setup>`, composables and plugins instead of reaching for `useNuxtApp()`. Every helper comes under its `$` name and a bare alias: `t` and `$t` are the same function.

## Signature

```ts
useI18n(): PluginsInjectionsWithAliases
```

Every runtime helper, as a plain object.

The same functions the plugin injects as `$t`, `$tc` and so on, available under both
the dollar-prefixed name and a bare alias — so `const { t } = useI18n()` and
`const { $t } = useI18n()` both work.

**Returns** — the helpers described in the [methods reference](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/methods)

```ts
const { t, tc, switchLocale, getLocale } = useI18n()

t('welcome', { name: 'Ada' })
tc('items', 3)
switchLocale('de')
```

The returned object holds every helper of [`PluginsInjections`](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/methods). Each one is documented on the [Helpers](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/methods) page.

## Example

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const { t, tc, localePath, switchLocale, getLocale } = useI18n()

const title = computed(() => t('page.title'))
</script>

<template>
  <h1>{{ title }}</h1>
  <p>{{ tc('items', 3) }}</p>
  <NuxtLink :to="localePath('/about')">{{ t('nav.about') }}</NuxtLink>
  <button @click="switchLocale(getLocale() === 'en' ? 'de' : 'en')">{{ t('nav.switch') }}</button>
</template>
```

## Not in the type

`$defineI18nRoute` is typed on `useNuxtApp()` only:

```ts
const { $defineI18nRoute } = useNuxtApp()
```

## Related

  :::card
  ---

  title: Helpers
  to: https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/methods
  ---
  Every helper with its signature
  :::

  :::card
  ---

  Locale state and cookie
  :::
